articleTitle: A Hybrid Method for Modeling of Capacitive Micromachined Ultrasonic Transducers (CMUTs)
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Capacitive micromachined ultrasonic transducers (CMUTs) have attracted diverse interests due to their advantages of wide bandwidth and easy integration over conventional piezoelectric ultrasonic transducers. Finite element analysis (FEA) and equivalent circuit modeling are the two common methods for the simulation and design of CMUTs, both of which have certain limitations. This paper proposes a hybrid method that combines the two methods, where the net impedance of the CMUT cell array is computed from the simulation result of a single cell’s FEA model and then used for predicting the electrical parameters of the equivalent circuit model. As a result, the hybrid model achieves the high accuracy of the FEA method and the high efficiency of the equivalent circuit model. Comparison between the simulation and experimental results has demonstrated the effectiveness of the hybrid method.

articleTitle: Adaptive Tracking Control of Mobile Robots based on Neural Network and Sliding Mode Methods
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive neural network sliding mode variable structure control strategy is proposed for the motion control of a nonholonomic mobile robot. Firstly, the pose tracking loop is established based on the kinematic model of the mobile robot, and the kinematic controller is designed by the backstepping method to solve the control relationship between pose and tracking velocity. Secondly, considering the dynamic model of the mobile robot, the velocity tracking loop is designed, and a sliding mode variable structure torque controller based on the combined approximation law is constructed. An adaptive neural sliding mode dynamic controller is designed based on the proportional-integral sliding mode control idea. The adaptive radial basis function neural networks (RBFNN) is used to compensate for the external disturbance, which effectively eliminates the influence of system uncertain parameters and external disturbance. Finally, the stability of the proposed system is proved according to Lyapunov’s theory. The simulation results verify the effectiveness and correctness of the control strategy.

articleTitle: Second Order Nonlinear Dynamic Inversion for Flight Segment Transition
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Flight segment transition (FST) is critical in all the phases of aviation. Its fast response and robustness require more efficiency to handle nonlinearities in guidance and control. However, how motion guidance can better serve attitude control rests on error feedback. We propose a feedforward superimposition approach of second order nonlinear dynamic inversion (SONDI) to coordinate the strategic, tactical, and operational timing in guidance, navigation, and control (GNC). We apply the SONDI approach in an autonomous flight mission involving FST tasks. Numerical results show that this approach can be superimposed on cascade control structures to improve the transition performance for admissible segment connections. Our approach represents a route to enhance the control effects of command feedforward superimposed on the original structures.

articleTitle: A Graph Convolutional Network with Ensemble Classifiers for 2D Skeleton-based Action Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we address the problem of action recognition from 2D skeletons produced by pose estimation algorithms. In practical applications, inaccurate joint information is inevitable due to self-occlusion and interaction with objects, which pose great challenges to 2D skeleton-based action recognition. To this end, we propose a graph convolutional network with ensemble classifiers to improve the robustness against noisy skeleton data. A global classifier learned from representations of the entire skeleton can capture the overall movement of the human body, while a set of part-based classifiers focuses on crucial local motion patterns. To further explore the correlations among joints within a part, we apply a self-attention mechanism to obtain context-aware part representations. Considering the existence of noisy joints, we develop a confidence-based weighting strategy to suppress classifiers based on inaccurate part representations. Experiments on the large-scale NTU-RGB+D dataset verify that the ensemble classifiers can boost the action recognition performance, especially on low-quality skeleton data with dense noise.

articleTitle: A Novel Bearing Fault Diagnosis Method Based on the DLM-CNN Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Bearings are critical components of rotating equipment with a high failure rate. Detecting faults in bearings is essential for improving the reliability and safety of rotating mechanical systems. In this paper, by combining the ability of deterministic learning mechanism (DLM) to accurately model the intrinsic dynamics of data and the automatic feature extraction capability of convolutional neural network (CNN), we propose a DLM-CNN framework for bearing fault diagnosis. To be specific, the inherent dynamics of raw vibration time series are first learned/modeled by the deterministic learning mechanism. The learned dynamics information is transformed into images and then fed into the CNN for automatic feature extraction. The discriminative features extracted by the CNN are used to efficiently classify health types as well as different bearing failure types. To verify the effectiveness of the proposed method, experiments are conducted on the Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) dataset with a classification accuracy of 98.89%.

articleTitle: Observer Method Design for Active Vibration Isolation System of Atomic Gravimeter
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Considering that the vibration isolation system of the atomic gravimeter is affected by ambient temperature, pressure, humidity, and other factors, the parameters such as the natural vibration frequency may change, and the system is also subject to random vibration interference from the ground. Because the control accuracy of the vibration isolation system can be significantly improved when there is no observation error, the control accuracy of the vibration isolation system is mainly limited by the observation accuracy. Design a high gain observer sliding mode control law to solve the problem that current control methods do not consider the randomness of external disturbances such as ground vibration and model uncertainty; By establishing a high gain observer sliding mode control, the vibration velocity and displacement of the active vibration isolation system of the cold atom gravimeter rapidly converge, thereby improving the control accuracy of the active vibration isolation system of the cold atom gravimeter.

articleTitle: A Real-Time VSLAM Based on Deep Features and Object Detection for Dynamic Environments
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The current simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) relies heavily on the hypothesis of static environments, and the localization accuracy and stability of the algorithm will be extremely affected when facing dynamic and complex environment. In response to this problem, a real-time visual SLAM system for dynamic environments is presented in this work, based on the ORB-SLAM3 algorithm for improvement. After obtaining the RGB images, the features are first extracted by the GCNv2 neural network, while the semantic information about the images is initially obtained using the lightweight target detection network YOLOv5. Then, based on the dynamic characteristics of the object between consecutive frames, the static feature points are obtained by eliminating its dynamic features to complete the pose estimation. The proposed algorithm is validated using the publicly available TUM dataset, and the experimental results show that the root mean square error of absolute trajectory error is reduced to 93.96% and 33.3% compared with ORB-SLAM3 and DS-SLAM, which improves the localization accuracy in dynamic scenes and also ensures the real-time performance of the system.

articleTitle: Distributed Periodic Event-Based Consensus Control for a Battery Management System with Time Delays
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A battery pack with many cells may gradually lose performance, causing uneven state-of-charge (SOC) and pack degradation. All batteries must have the same SOC in order to achieve equilibrium. We will also take into account how each cell’s output power and the demand are balanced. In this study, the SOCs of batteries of various capacities are balanced using a battery management system (BMS) in the context of an electric car battery pack, as well as the output power supply and delay demand of each battery. The outcomes of using this idea are shown with the use of an example.

articleTitle: Segmentation and Extraction of Maize Phytomers Using 3D Data Acquired by RGB-D Cameras
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Based-field Individual-level crop organ extraction is an important prerequisite for high-throughput crop phenotyping. Phytomer is the organ propagation unit that connects the leaf and stem nodes, and it can be used to measure a variety of morphological phenotypic parameters. However, the severe occlusion across neighboring crops in dense field scenes leads to difficulties for crop organ point cloud extraction. To tackle this challenge, we study phytomer extraction methods based on point density features. In this paper, we propose a point cloud segmentation approach for individual-level crop organs based on point density histograms and cubic B-sample curve fitting, and also propose a phytomer construction approach based on point cloud color information and density features. To verify the effectiveness of our approach, we conduct field experiments under open-field conditions with a mobile robot equipped with RGB-D cameras. The experimental results show that the phytomer construction approach based on point density features can accurately extract the organ units reflecting the real crop morphology. Based on the statistical analysis of 15 sets of test datasets, we found that the success rate of phytomer construction is up to 89.2%.

articleTitle: Identification and Tracking of Main Material of Transmission Tower Based on Monocular RGB Photography
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the recognition and tracking of transmission tower main materials in single RGB photography environment. Considering the photographic noise in complex environments, this paper models the photographic image using line features, analyzes the 3D-2D camera photographic model of transmission tower main material features, the spatial motion model of rigid bodies and the motion model of transmission tower main material line features in photographic images. A recognition and tracking method for transmission tower main materials is designed, which integrates Kalman filtering and probability modeling. Experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively track transmission tower main materials and exhibits good robustness in complex environments. At the same time, the method proposed in this paper also has high speed, accuracy and stability, and can meet the needs of tracking and recognition of transmission tower main materials in power transmission and distribution systems.

articleTitle: Traceability Analysis of Anomalous Production Indexes based on Probabilistic Grey Number Fuzzy Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Industrial systems have intricate cause-and-effect relationships within them, and when undesirable operations happen simultaneously, their interaction makes it difficult for process personnel to track down anomalies in production results. Many of the methods proposed based on Petri nets now allow for efficient reasoning and analysis of knowledge and are becoming a common diagnostic tool. However, there are still many limitations to the imperfect information existing in industrial systems and the reasoning environment that relies on subjective empirical judgments. Therefore, based on the fuzzy Petri net model proposed by previous authors, probability grey numbers were introduced for the first time in the causal relationship between variables, extending the knowledge representation in the case of insufficient information, thus establishing an algebraic algorithm for probability grey numbers and proposing a probability grey number fuzzy Petri net model, which makes knowledge explicit and also significantly enhances the representation of uncertain knowledge of anomalous indicators with traceability analysis. Finally, the validity of the proposed PGFPN model is shown by using examples from the flotation industry.

articleTitle: Novel multi-step mean sampling based long short term memory network for Remaining Useful Life Prediction of Bearings
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Rolling bearing, known as "industrial joint", is essential components of rotating machinery, which is widely used in the aerospace, machinery manufacturing and medical devices. The remaining useful life (RUL) prediction of bearing can determine the time when the target equipment needs to be repaired or replaced, which can carry out maintenance in advance to reduce the number of unnecessary repairs. The RUL analysis can give warning in advance to prevent accidents. Therefore, it avoids the resources waste caused by downtime due to faults, saves manpower and material resources, and improves the production efficiency of mechanical equipment. To uncover the concealed information in time series data and identify the time-based and spatial features present in bearing vibration data, this paper proposes a novel RUL prediction method using an improved multi-step mean sampling (MMS) based long short-term memory network (LSTM) method (MMS-LSTM). This proposed method adds a multi-step sampler to the original LSTM network. The multi-step sampler can sample and fuse the original data by setting different step sizes, so as to fully extract the hidden features in the original data and expand the perception field, which can improve the prediction effect and the feature extraction ability of the proposed method. Finally, the performance of the proposed MMS-LSTM is verified in the RUL prediction task on the public bearing dataset PHM2012. The experimental results show that MMS-LSTM outperforms other methods in terms of average absolute percentage error, root mean square error, and average absolute error, such as backpropagation neural network (BP), radial basis function neural network (RBF), and LSTM.

articleTitle: Robust Filter Algorithm for Underwater Navigation System Aided by Chi-square Information
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the influence of unknown and outnumber of measurement noise on the positioning accuracy of integrated navigation system in underwater complex environment. This paper presents a robust filter algorithm of SINS/DVL/USBL integrated navigation aided by chi-square information. Firstly, an optimal state estimation method based on Bayesian estimation is presented. On this basis, the cost function is introduced, and the robust Huber M estimation Kalman filter algorithm is given through the cost function calculation. Secondly, to solve the problem of continuous outlier interference, an improved Huber M filter algorithm based on the new chi-square detection method is proposed. The above method can suppress the influence of continuous non-Gaussian strong noise and improve the filtering accuracy and stability. Finally, the validity of the method is verified by the Yangtze River experiment.

articleTitle: The requirement and applications of equipment integrity management in petrochemical enterprises
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The industrial Internet is a new industrial ecology, key infrastructure and new application mode that deeply integrates the new generation of information and communication technology with the industrial economy. It is based on the network, platform as the hub, data as the element, security as the guarantee, through the comprehensive connection of human, machine and material, it changes the traditional manufacturing mode, production organization mode and industrial form. The construction of a new industrial manufacturing and service system connecting the whole factors, the whole industrial chain and the whole value chain is the key and difficult point of enterprise management for supporting the construction of a strong manufacturing country and a strong network country, upgrading the modernization level of the industrial chain, promoting high-quality economic development, and building a new development pattern. At present, there are some problems in equipment management of domestic petrochemical enterprises, such as low efficiency of comprehensive management, insufficient integration of information system, difficulty in data sharing, inadequate integration of risk management technology, high maintenance cost, and great loss of shutdown. In recent years, the petrochemical industry equipment caused by the frequent production safety accidents, equipment management concept from institutionalized management to systematic management, digital, networking, intelligent importance of increasingly prominent. Statistics from the National Industrial Information Security Development and Research Center for the digital transformation of industrial enterprises show that equipment management and service demand account for the highest proportion. It is an inevitable choice to build a comprehensive and integrated equipment integrity management platform.

articleTitle: Teleoperation Method For Controlling Robotic Arm Based On Multi-channel EMG Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Human-in-the-loop teleoperation is the mainstream technical approach of robotic arm control at this stage, and has great research significance and application value. The teleoperation is often affected by the time delay, which leads to the destabilization of the control, and how to reduce the time delay is an urgent problem in teleoperation. To address the time delay problem of teleoperation, this paper proposes a teleoperation method based on multi-channel electromyography (EMG) signals to control the robotic arm by using the advanced characteristic of bioelectric information decision-making compared with traditional behavioral decision-making, which effectively shortens the path of information transmission and reduces the impact of time delay on teleoperation. By collecting the contraction or diastole EMG signals of multi-channel human muscles, the robot arm is conditioned and controlled, and it can freely define different operations of the robot arm in different muscle states of different channels, such as the opening and closing of mechanical claws and the twisting of different nodes of multiple robot arms. Compared with the traditional control methods, it is more in line with human intuition and further reduces the time delay, which has some innovative and application value in the field of human-computer interaction.

articleTitle: State of Health Estimation of Lithium-ion Battery Based on Pre-LN Transformer
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Accurate estimation of the state of health (SOH) and remaining useful life of lithium-ion battery is crucial to the safe operation of electric vehicles. In order to accurately estimate the SOH, a new model called Pre-LN Transformer is proposed. It is an improvement of Transformer, which can safely remove the warm-up stage of learning rate and reduce a lot of training time. Different artificial neural networks (i.e., GRU, RNN, LSTM, Transformer) are used for comparison, and experiments are conducted on NASA data sets and CALCE data sets to verify the advantages of the models used. The comparison results show that the proposed method is more accurate and stable in predicting SOH. The mean square error(MSE) of PreLN Transformer model on CS35 is as low as 0.008%.

articleTitle: Adaptive Adjustment Algorithm of Subtitle Screen Brightness
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Subtitle is very important to the stage presentation of performing arts, and the brightness of the subtitle screen affects the performance experience. This paper analyzes the role of subtitle in different performing arts and designs an adaptive luminance adjustment algorithm for subtitle screen combined with human visual characteristics and optimizes it.

articleTitle: Identification of the unknown parameters of the linear wave equation from the sensor output data
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we study the problem of parameter identification for linear wave equations with dynamic boundary conditions. Using the finite difference method to discretize the time and space variables of the wave equation, a system of ordinary differential equations is obtained. With reasonable discretization, finite dimensional systems can approximate infinite dimensional systems. The ordinary differential equations are further organized to obtain a more recognizable expression form and the unknown parameters are hidden in the coefficient matrix in the form of linear combinations. Each element in the coefficient matrix is identified by the least square method, the discrete unknown parameters can be obtained by the inverse solution, and the general expression of the unknown parameters can be obtained by selecting the appropriate fitting method. Finally, simulation examples are given, and the results confirm the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Consensus of Strict Feedback Nonlinear MAS with Disturbance based on Dynamic Event-triggered
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this research, the system with strict feedback dynamic model is considered, the consensus analysis is carried out for the system with disturbance under directed graph. Through high gain technology, the issue of system consistency was further analyzed. Then, the consensus controller is designed by algebraic Riccati equation. By introducing dynamic variables, a dynamic event triggering mechanism is proposed. Moreover, combined with the knowledge of stability related theorem, it proves that the system can reach state consistency in a finite amount of time. At last, through MATLAB simulation, the feasibility of the designed algorithm is verified.

articleTitle: Electric Energy Trading Mechanism of Distributed Electric Vehicles in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the continuous development of the smart grid and the increasing number of electric vehicles (EVs), the power transaction in the smart grid has become increasingly important in our daily life. This paper studies the distributed trading mechanism of electric vehicle energy in a smart grid. First, a non-cooperative game model is established among EV users. Each user can buy and sell power to both the central grid and other EV users. EV owners may act as buyers or sellers in the transaction according to their power availability. Next, this paper calculates the optimal utility function for EV users and obtains the optimal decision. The expression of the Nash equilibrium solution and the optimal user utility function are given. Then the efficiency of Nash equilibrium is analyzed. Finally, demand response management is carried out under the model. This paper designs two groups of comparative experiments. The first experiment compared daily electricity consumption and electricity charges of users before and after demand response management. The second experiment showed how the sum of electricity bills changed with the number of users who don’t change their habits.

articleTitle: Gait Simulation of Snake Robot Based on ROS
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Snake robots have broad application prospects in many fields. Referring to the gait of biological snakes in nature, this paper develops a simulation platform for snake robot models based on ROS (Robot Operating System). First, introduce the advantages of ROS for robot development, and choose the appropriate simulation platform by comparing the advantages and disadvantages of various simulation platforms. Secondly, the kinematics analysis and modeling of the snake robot are carried out. On this basis, the motion path of the snake robot is planned, and the angle changes of each joint of the robot are calculated according to the gait equation of the snake robot. Finally, import the snake robot model file into ROS, write the snake robot gait motion program through the user, and use the Gazebo simulator to simulate the snake robot movement gait.

articleTitle: A Transmission Line Planning Method Based on Variable Size Grid and Improved Ant Colony Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Route planning for transmission lines has always been an important part of the power construction industry. In the past, however, such planning has involved many critical steps, not only collecting complex geographic information data, but also performing personnel calculations. The collected data needed to be analyzed by engineers, and then safety and reliability were taken into account to determine the lowest economic cost route option. This traditional approach is not only very consuming for personnel, but also lacks reliability. This is because the development of the scheme is too dependent on the experience and decision making of the personnel. Now this paper proposes an intelligent route selection algorithm that improves on the ant colony optimization (ACO) algorithm. Unlike previous route planning algorithms that are based on fixed size grid (FSG) maps, this paper uses variable size grid (VSG) maps to replace the maps with fixed-size grids. This not only reduces the number of grids in the route search to speed up the search speed, but also better fits the terrain to improve the rationality of the route. Then the grid node structure of the variable size grid is optimized. Then the heuristic function of the ACO algorithm is improved, and the parallel search based on variable-size grids is adopted. This not only improves the efficiency, but also increases the chance of searching the global optimal route. Finally, route optimization is performed on the routes to achieve smoothing process and reduce the cost of the towers.

articleTitle: SAR image ship detection based on light-weight multi-scale feature enhancement network
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of insufficient detection performance due to complex background and small-scale characteristics of the target in SAR-based image ship detection applications, this paper constructs a lightweight multi-scale feature enhancement network based on deep learning algorithms for ship detection. The network first extracts the ship features in the image by using the light-weighted and improved VGG-16 network, and designs a two-way feature fusion module to forward fuse and reverse fuse the low-level detail features and high-level semantic features respectively to achieve multi-scale feature aggregation; then introduces a convolutional block attention module to enhance the network's ability to extract ship features in complex scenes from the perspective of both channel features and spatial features. Further, the K-means clustering algorithm is used to optimize the anchor scale design based on the real border information of ship targets to enhance the classification and localization accuracy of the network for multi-scale ship targets; finally, the Soft-NMS algorithm is introduced to improve the leakage detection problem in the densely distributed ship scenes. The detection performance of the network is verified using the SAR image ship dataset SSDD, and the research results show that the detection accuracy of the network is 95.12% and the detection speed is 18.7 FPS, which is 6.88% higher than that of the Faster R-CNN network in terms of detection accuracy and more than 2 times higher in terms of detection efficiency, effectively improving the ship detection performance of small-scale targets in complex backgrounds. It can meet the demand of high accuracy and real-time detection of ship targets in SAR images.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis Of Time-varying Delay Systems Based On Generalized Free Weight Integral Inequality
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, the stability of linear time-delay systems with time-varying intervals is analyzed. According to the existing theorems and research methods, the generalized free weight matrix integral inequality (GFMBII) is used to improve the augmented Lyapunov-Krasovskii function (ALKF). The method can reduce the use of matrix variables, to calculate the maximum stability margin of the system. At the end of the paper, the accuracy of the proposed theorem is testified by comparing numerical examples with other literature and MATLAB simulation results.

articleTitle: A Visual SLAM Algorithm Based on Instance Segmentation and Background Inpainting in Dynamic Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Traditional SLAM algorithms are difficult to efficiently match feature points in dynamic scenes, which therefore directly affects trajectory accuracy. Therefore, a visual SLAM algorithm based on instance segmentation and background inpainting in dynamic scenes(IDV-SLAM) is proposed. This algorithm firstly designs a LaS-FPN module to increase the feature learning ratio of large objects, thereby accurately marking potential dynamic objects. We also apply multi-view geometry method to remove dynamic points to reduce the impact of dynamic objects on the positioning accuracy of the SLAM system. According to the optimal grid mapping method, the static background of the culling area is completed, and the ORB features are extracted for feature matching. We use the public TUM dataset to evaluate our algorithm, and the experimental results show that the our algorithm in this paper improves the trajectory accuracy and has better composition ability.

articleTitle: Fixed-time Affine Formation Control with Adaptive TBG Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper focus on studying affine formation problem by using a distributed adaptive Time-base Generator (TBG) Technique. Based on this algorithm, we solve the fixed-time formation control problem of leaderless and leader-follower system and give the corresponding simulation verification. And this paper combines TBG technology with affine formation control for the first time, providing new ideas for solving affine formation control problems.

articleTitle: Cluster consensus control of nonlinear multi-agent system with switching topology and uncertain disturbances via event-triggered strategy*
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Under the distributed event-triggered control strategy, the cluster consensus of NMASs with switching topology and uncertain disturbances is investigated. Event-triggered control strategy is only executed when the trigger conditions are satisfied, which can reduce energy consumption in the control process. In order to be close to reality, the system considers switching topology and the external uncertain disturbances. By means of using Lyapunov stability theory, algebraic graph theory and matrix theory, some sufficient conditions for achieving consensus of NMASs clusters are obtained. In addition, it is proved that eliminate Zeno phenomenon under event-triggered control scheme. Finally, an example simulation is given to verified the validity of the theoretical results.

articleTitle: Sign Language Recognition Based On Facial Expression and Hand Skeleton
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Sign language is a visual language used by the deaf and dumb community to communicate. However, for most recognition methods based on monocular cameras, the recognition accuracy is low and the robustness is poor. Even if the effect is good on some data, it may perform poorly in other data with different interference due to the inability to extract effective features. To solve these problems, we propose a sign language recognition network that integrates skeleton features of hands and facial expression. Among this, we propose a hand skeleton feature extraction based on coordinate transformation to describe the shape of the hand more accurately. Moreover, by incorporating facial expression information, the accuracy and robustness of sign language recognition are finally improved, which was verified on A Dataset for Argentinian Sign Language and SEU’s Chinese Sign Language Recognition Database (SEUCSLRD).

articleTitle: Full-coverage confidence function path planning algorithm for mobile robots
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We propose a full-coverage path planning algorithm for mobile robots based on a raster confidence function. The algorithm aims to address the problem of guiding a mobile robot to traverse all reachable points in the working area while ensuring automatic obstacle avoidance. To achieve this, we assign a raster map based on environmental information and utilize different function values to represent obstacles, covered raster, and uncovered raster areas. This algorithm provides an effective solution for achieving full coverage in path planning for mobile robots, ensuring efficient exploration of the working area while avoiding obstacles; second, different directional confidence functions are introduced to determine whether the robot is caught in a dead zone, and the raster function values are adjusted. Finally, the robot generates the coverage path using the raster confidence function values. This algorithm not only enables the mobile robot to achieve complete coverage of the working area but also allows it to efficiently escape from dead zones and minimize path repetition. In the simulation experiments, it is demonstrated that the algorithm mentioned in this paper has higher coverage efficiency by comparing it with the bio-inspired neural network algorithm.

articleTitle: Pedestrian Detection and Trajectory-Tracking based FMCW radar For Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The perception of pedestrian movement is an arduous task for onboard sensors, yet a crucial aspect of autonomous driving development. On this account, this paper presents a novel FMCW 4D radar-based detection and tracking system for pedestrian targets in low signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) conditions. Specifically, the keystone transform-constant false alarm ratio (KT-CFAR) is proposed to correct range migration (RM), and achieve superior target detection. Then we employ the multiple signal classification (MUSIC) algorithm to enhance angle resolution. Lastly, the particle filtering (PF) algorithm is utilized to track pedestrian targets. Through extensive simulation and experimental validation, the proposed method achieves better results, exhibiting outstanding performance with an RMSE of 0.6173 m.

articleTitle: Attitude solving method based on fusion of Madgwick and EFK
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A fusion algorithm combing Madgwick and extended Kalman filter (EKF) is proposed to solve the problem of low accuracy of micro inertial measurement unit and significant error of traditional attitude solution method. Firstly, the inertial measurement sensor data is fused with the madgwick filter, by solving which the initial attitude quaternion is obtained. Using the quaternion as the measurement information of EKF, then establishing its state equation according to the angular velocity and acceleration information measured by the sensor. Finally, the solution information of attitude is obtained by EKF filtering. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional algorithm, the improved fusion algorithm can restrain the errors caused by the drastic changes of the accelerometer more effectively, which can filter the non-gravity acceleration noise well in both static and dynamic conditions and improve the speed and accuracy of the attitude solution.

articleTitle: Rolling bearing fault diagnosis based on Attention LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) is well-suited for handling time-series data due to its ability to recognize dependencies between consecutive time points. In recent years, diagnosing rolling bearing faults using LSTM has garnered considerable interest. However, the memory bottleneck issue arises when LSTM is applied to long sequences, leading to the propagation of irrelevant information within the network. In this study, we propose an Attention LSTM fault diagnosis method. By incorporating the attention mechanism, this method concentrates on varying amounts of information in different LSTM gates. This approach aims to enhance the network's feature extraction capability, minimize the spread of unnecessary information, and address LSTM's memory bottleneck problem. The proposed method's effectiveness is confirmed through experiments on benchmark data.

articleTitle: Superresolution reconstruction based on complementary composite structural illumination
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Structured illumination moves high-frequency information with more details into the frequency band that the optical system can pass through, so as to achieve high-quality image super-resolution (SR) reconstruction. Although structured illumination microscopy (SIM) using this technique are already mature for optical SR imaging, continuous illumination through unidirectional multi-frame sinusoidal structured patterns greatly reduces temporal resolution and poses challenges for robust imaging in low-light and short-exposure environments. In order to introduce more high-frequency information into the original image with fewer frames, we propose an innovative illumination method using compound angle structured patterns. Only one frame of the structured pattern is loaded on a spatial light modulator (SLM), and then two images are captured by complementary modulation. The reconstruction algorithm uses end-to-end deep neural networks. In order to improve the applicability under real low-light conditions, we simulate the actual noise scenes for model training. Experimental results show that our method is robust to noise and can restore image details under low-light conditions to achieve image SR. Moreover, it effectively minimizes the exposure time of image acquisition and reduces the computing time of the network, leading to an enhancement in the efficiency of image reconstruction.

articleTitle: Terminal velocity and impact angle control based on generalized polynomial guidance
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to control terminal velocity and impact angle during a missile’s descent phase using a simple dynamic model. This approach involves obtaining the acceleration control command from the generalized polynomial after normalizing the residual range. Then the gradient descent method is used to predict the terminal velocity and adjust the guidance parameters. Finally, numerical simulation results show that the approach achieves the guidance objective under various constraints of terminal velocity and impact angle through.

articleTitle: Offline detection technology of source-network coordination performance of generator network-related protection
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The geographical distribution of energy resources in China is very uneven, whether it is conventional energy or renewable clean energy. In addition, with the growth of electricity demand, the proportion of the grid in the energy transmission system is increasing, and the continuous growth of load size and cross-regional power flow scale promotes the expansion of the grid size and the increase of the grid complexity. The complexity of power grid security and stability control will be greatly increased and the centralized access of large renewable energy bases will bring new technical problems to the safe operation of power grid. The sending end is connected to a large number of renewable energy sources, such as wind power generation, and the power fluctuation is large. In addition, the UHV DC project is in the early stage of operation, the construction of supporting facilities is weak, and the UHV DC near generators are in a critical state for a long time. At this point, generator stator and rotor overcurrents and other limits may operate when renewable energy power fluctuates, and it is difficult to objectively assess the compatibility of limits and protections due to the wide variation in the implementation principles of limits and protections among different manufacturers. When the system fails or fails, the control system of the generator set will participate in the adjustment to restore the system to a stable operating state. If the control system parameters and protection are not properly coordinated, protection may be caused before the control action, and the generator set will be cut off. The system that has been hit loses more active and reactive power support, and the power system's performance deteriorates. Therefore, it is necessary to study the evaluation indexes of the protection and control of the near area generator set of UHV DC project and the cooperation performance of the grid.

articleTitle: Optimization algorithm for closed-loop detection based on similarity fusion mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To solve the problems of low closed-loop accuracy and error-prone loopback in the closed-loop detection thread of traditional SLAM algorithm, this article proposes a new similarity fusion mechanism for closed-loop detection optimization algorithm, which calculates the fused similarity of key frames of suspected loopback frames for further validation, and selects high-quality loopback key frames to improve the efficiency of closed-loop detection while reducing the occurrence of error loopback. The algorithm is validated in the KITTI public dataset and can effectively improve the accuracy of the SLAM system and generate globally consistent maps.

articleTitle: Design of Distributed ADMM Optimization Algorithm with Limited Communication Data Bits
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We consider a situation where there are limited communication data bits in the communication channel between agents. In response, we propose a new hybrid quantizer based on the uniform and logarithmic quantizers. Using this quantizer, we design a distributed alternating direction multiplier method (ADMM) optimization algorithm that employs dynamic encoding and decoding methods. The algorithm can achieve linear convergence to the optimal solution if the local objective function is strongly convex and the gradient is Lipschitz continuous. Compared to previous work, our proposed dynamic quantization scheme eliminates the influence of quantization errors and ensures precise convergence of the algorithm, even with limited communication data bits. It is worth noting that our new quantizer requires significantly fewer quantization levels compared to previous quantizers, thus greatly improving communication efficiency.

articleTitle: Genetic algorithm based optimized least squares support vector machine for grate pressure prediction in grate coolers
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: As an essential part of cement clinker industrial production, the main task of the grate cooler is to cool the high temperature cement clinker; at the same time, the heat recovery of the high temperature gas generated during the cooling process. The working condition of the grate cooler and the cooling effect of the clinker is measured primarily by the pressure under the grate plate of the grate cooler. Therefore, a method based on genetic algorithm (GA) optimization of least squares support vector machine (LS_SVM) model parameters is proposed to predict the pressure under the grate of a grate cooler. The optimization calculation of LS_SVM model parameters is achieved through GA, which solves the limitation of LS_SVM prediction accuracy by model parameters.

articleTitle: Risk Avoidance System of Unmanned Surface Vehicle Based on GeoNetworking Communication Mode
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, a risk avoidance system of unmanned surface vehicle (USV) based on the GeoNetworking communication mode (GEO mode) is introduced by authors. The risk avoidance system of USV adapted to the GEO communication mechanism is designed and constructed according to the practical requirements of the USV risk avoidance scenario. The system structure mainly consists of ship hull, GEO routing base station module, shipborne routing module, GEO warning area information transmission program, and network bridge communication module. The structure, functional features, and framework of the system will be introduced. And through practical experiments on water, the effectiveness of the system is verified. The USV risk avoidance system is designed to carry out the information transmission of the danger area in GEO mode and perform the USV risk avoidance mission by analyzing the information.

articleTitle: The Research on the Intelligent Control Technology of Stage Automation
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Stage scenery is very important for the stage presentation of performing arts, and movable stagecraft sets are becoming more and more common. This paper analyzes the function of the movement of the stage based on many concrete cases, and expounds the matters that should be paid attention to in the design and debugging of the movement of the stage scenery from the angle of intelligent control.

articleTitle: Vision-based control of supernumerary robotic limbs for grasping tasks
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Accuracy is a crucial factor when robots interact with humans in certain industrial tasks, such as grasping tasks. Therefore, the main goal of this paper is to propose a method to improve the accuracy of supernumerary robotic limbs (SRL) for assisting humans to complete tasks. First, the kinematics of the supernumerary robotic limbs is analyzed, and the kinematics of the six degrees of freedom are analyzed to lay the theoretical foundation for the subsequent experiments. Using Kinect as an image collection device, the YOLOv5 method without candidate regions is trained with a training set to recognize object information. Additionally, a Generative Residual Convolutional Neural Network (GRCNN) method is used to predict the parameters such as position and angle of the grasping task. After coordinate transformation, location of crawl is obtained through MoveIt for trajectory planning, and then controlling the mechanical claw of SRL to perform the grasping task. Simulation results verify the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Multi-rate Aperiodic Sampled-data Quadrotor UAVs
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of exponential stability analysis for multi-rate aperiodic sampled-data control of the quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicle. A new stability-equivalent feedback interconnection model under the three control loops of attitude, position and velocity is proposed. based on this, the competing cheap exponential stability criterion is obtained. The sampled-data behavior is independent of each other in the three control loops, and each channel is selected for aperiodic sampled-data. The influence of sampled-data and delay on the system is represented by a diagonal structured operator and is estimated by an explicit upper bound on the operator’s norm. Simulation results show that the control of multiple control loops permits a more flexible adjustment of the sampled-data frequency, thus reducing the waste of resources. Single-rate sampled-data is also applicable as a special case.

articleTitle: Multi - Environment Image Dehazing Algorithm Based on Color Channel Attenuation Difference
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we propose a multi-environment image dehazing algorithm based on the color channel attenuation difference(ME-DCAD). The algorithm possesses several unique features: firstly, it uses a combination of the Beer-Lambert law and the light square attenuation law to more accurately define the relationship between light attenuation and distance; secondly, it estimates the transmission rate by calculating the difference in attenuation with distance through different color channels, which results in good dehazing effects in both underwater and hazy environments; thirdly, it considers the problem of dust accumulation on the lens and can be applied in environments including scenarios involving coke inspection in factories. Through comparative experiments with similar methods, our proposed method exhibits certain image deblurring and enhancement performance and performs well in various environments, improving the image quality obtained in hazy environments.

articleTitle: Data-Driven Frequency Regulation Method for Multi-Terminal HVDC Grids
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: High voltage direct current (HVDC) lines allow low-loss transmission over long distances. The multi-terminal HVDC network consists of multiple terminals connected by HVDC lines, and each area shares the frequency reserve. Through secondary frequency control, the frequency of AC and DC areas can be regulated back to the set point when the system frequency has deviated. In this paper, a data-driven model predictive control (MPC) strategy is proposed. The Kooman operator is used to obtain the high-dimensional linear model of a nonlinear system, and the Deep Learning method is used to approximate the infinite-dimensional Koopman operator. The nominal MPC is used for optimization and control, and the optimal problem is solved for the Koopman linearized system. The optimal control is applied to the original nonlinear system. Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Transient Dynamics of Three Nuclear Spin Ensembles in Spin-Exchange Relaxation-Free Co-Magnetometers
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Spin-exchange relaxation-free co-magnetometers have a great potential to work as a gyroscope for inertial navigation, but the poor dynamic performance restricts their future application. An object of this paper is to investigate the dynamic performance of three different nuclear spin ensembles and the variation of the dynamic perfomance with cell temperature and noble gas pressure, respectively. The theoratical model of the transient response is applied to research the spin precessions of different noble gases, and we use the nuclear decay rate to represent the dynamic performance. A simulation model of SERF co-magnetometers is conducted so that we can obtain the relevant parameters of the transient response. Simulation results show that the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">129</sup>Xe ensembles have better dynamic performance than <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">21</sup>Ne and <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>He ensembles at the respective fastest point. Meanwhile, the simulation results perform differently at the compensation point where the nuclear decay rate is the fastest in the <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>He ensembles owing to the leastest magnetic field of alkali-metal spins. Moreover, the system exhibits a faster decay rate under the condition of higher cell temperature and noble gas pressure. The study provides reference for the component design of the alkali-metal cell in co-magnetometers.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Adaptive Control for First-Order Multi-agent Systems with Unknown Control Direction
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper examines distributed cooperative control for Multi-agent Systems (MASs) interconnected by directed graphs. Each agent's dynamics are characterized by first-order dynamics, featuring unknown control directions and external disturbances. To handle with unknown directions, Nussbaum-type gain technique and adaptive control are applied in the design of consensus algorithm. Firstly, we give first-order MASs a consensus algorithm, which based on event-triggered mechanism. It is shown that use this consensus algorithm, the first-order MASs reach consensus ultimately, and are no continuous transmission of information. Finally, some numerical simulation is show the effectiveness of the consensus algorithm.

articleTitle: General decay anti-synchronization of coupled delayed memristive neural networks
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, the network models of coupled delayed memristive neural networks (CDMNNs) without and with delayed coupling are studied respectively. Firstly, according to the definitions of ψ-type stability and ψ -type function, the notion of general decay anti-synchronization (GDAS) is introduced. Secondly, by constructing Lyapunov functional, designing controller and using inequality techniques, the corresponding sufficient conditions that reaching GDAS for CDMNNs with and without delayed coupling are deduced. Thirdly, the validity of the results is proved by proper numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Automatic Recognition and Positioning of Aerial Refueling Cone Sleeve Based on Depth Camera
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The existing aircraft aerial automatic refueling technology mostly uses binocular vision camera to measure the relative positioning of the refueling cone sleeve. However, due to the limitations of the airframe, the position of the binocular vision camera is relatively close, so the photographic baseline is relatively short, resulting in high plane accuracy and relatively low distance accuracy in the position calculation, which has a certain impact on the aircraft aerial automatic refueling. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a method of aerial refueling cone recognition and auxiliary positioning based on depth camera. This method first obtains the depth image of the refueling cone sleeve through the depth camera, then converts the depth image into a three-dimensional point cloud for the target recognition of the refueling cone sleeve, and finally obtains the distance information from the refueling cone sleeve to the depth camera, thus improving the disadvantage of the poor accuracy of the distance positioning measurement of the binocular vision camera. Through laboratory verification, the average error of distance measured by this method is 0.003 meters, which verifies the feasibility of this method.

articleTitle: An Improved Equivalent-Input-Disturbance Approach of Disturbances Rejection in Time-Varying State-Delay Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This study presents a novel system configuration and design technique to mitigate an external disturbance in a time-varying state-delay system. Within the system’s framework, there exists a plant that serves as an observer, reconstructing its present condition, a more advanced EID estimator that assesses the overall influence of the external disturbance as well as the steady-state element of the fluctuating delay, a controller that utilizes PI to improve the stability of the control system is also included. The stability requirement can be expressed through the utilization of a linear matrix inequality (LMI). The LMI is employed in the creation of the gains for both the PI controller and the state observer. The numerical example serves to illustrate the efficacy of the approach. Furthermore, the method’s validity and superiority are demonstrated by comparing the provided approach with a PI control, an EID-based control, and a traditional PI-EID control system.

articleTitle: On robust output regulation of four strings*
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Based on our recent work [1], this paper focuses on the potential relationship between two ways to design observer based control, namely based on either three exosystem observers or two exosystem observers. Both can introduce a 3-copy internal model structure. We further explain the potential relationship between the above observer systems. The tracking errors can be converged to zero and the system states of the closed-loop system are bounded. There are two simulation examples to show the effectiveness of the observer based robust controls.

articleTitle: Shape control of multi-segment soft manipulator with error constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, we design a shape control method for multi-segment soft manipulators, and ensures that the bending angle error at the boundary of each segment does not exceed a settable threshold. In the model building part, the dynamic model of the soft manipulator is described by partial differential equations by extending Hamilton’s principle. Afterwards, the steady state of the soft manipulator is analyzed to obtain the steady state system, and the barrier Lyapunov function (BLF) is constructed to limit the regulation error of each segment. Then the asymptotic stability of the model under this control method is proved based on the Lyapunov method. Finally, the performance of the proposed control method is verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: A Perception-Prediction System Design Using 3D Point Clouds
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Robot safety depends in part on the ability to detect moving objects and predict their motions. Although various related algorithms have been proposed, both the real-time performance and robustness of perception and prediction still need to be improved. This paper designs a real-time and reliable perception-prediction system to perceive the obstacle and predict trajectories by using 3D point clouds. The perception-prediction system includes five modules, which preserve the low-computational characteristic. A compensation module is proposed to improve the tracking performance when an obstacle is perceived. Moreover, a stabilization module including spline interpolation, filtering, and Gaussian noise is provided to improve the prediction accuracy. Finally, experimental results are given to demonstrate the effectiveness and advantages of the proposed perception-prediction system.

articleTitle: Multi-quadrotor UAVs formation obstacle avoidance control based on virtual leader
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of quadrotor UAV formation obstacle avoidance with external disturbances and multiple obstacles, a distributed formation obstacle avoidance control method based on the combination of virtual leader and repulsion function is designed. With the trajectory of the virtual leader as the core, the desired formation trajectory is designed according to the desired relative position deviation, and the obstacle avoidance is realized by combining the repulsive function. Based on the adaptive integral backstepping method to realize the tracking control of the quadrotor UAV on the desired formation trajectory, the adaptive algorithm is used to estimate the external disturbance and eliminate the influence of the disturbance on the system, and the differential explosion problem in the backstepping control is solved by using a filter. The simulation experiment proves that the quadrotor UAV can quickly respond to form the required formation and achieve reasonable collision avoidance against multiple obstacles, which fully verifies the viability of the designed formation avoidance method.

articleTitle: Law of electromagnetic radiation of launch vehicle wireless signal in tower environment
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to study the wireless electromagnetic distribution of a new launch vehicle in the closed tower, a multi-antenna model of complex environment with tower-arrow body is establised in this paper. In conjunction with the UG NX modeling and Altair Hyper Works 2017 electromagnetic compatibility simulation platform. The characteristics of near-field and far-filed distribution under single-channel feeds are studied. The research results have guiding significance for the formulation, optimization and fault solving of the test scheme for the wireless system at the launch site.

articleTitle: Path Planning in Dynamic Environments through Trajectory Prediction and Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Due to the presence of dynamic obstacles, like pedestrians and other mobile robots, on-line path planning for mobile robots in dynamic environments becomes challenging. Many traditional methods are based on off-line path planning, and replan a feasible path when dynamic obstacles appear. However, these methods often fail to plan a path in many cases due to robot deadlocks and oscillating movements. Many deep neural network-based approaches try to solve these problems by introducing learning-based techniques for dynamic environments. However, such models often cause detours because of the lack of the motion characteristics of dynamic obstacles. To address this issue, we propose a two-stage learning-based model. In the first stage, our model extracts surrounding environment features and dynamic characteristics of obstacles, and outputs predicted trajectories of obstacles. In the second stage, our model plans a feasible and efficient path for mobile robots by reinforcement learning and the predicted trajectories. We evaluate our method across different maps. The result shows that our model successfully completes planning in various dynamic environments, and shows outstanding predictability and processing capacity for dynamic obstacles.

articleTitle: Distributed Consensus Control for Euler-Lagrange Systems under Switching Topologies
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the distributed consensus control problem for multiple Euler-Lagrange systems under switching topologies. Firstly, to accurately estimate the state information of the leader, an observer which is integrated with switching signal is constructed. Then, the consensus problem for Euler-Lagrange systems under switching topologies is transformed into a tracking problem. Different from some existing results, the proposed control strategy is applicable to systems without directed spanning tree in some topologies by designing the appropriate switch signals that meet general rules. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed consensus algorithms is proved according to Lyapunov theory and verified via a simulation example.

articleTitle: Consensus of Multiweighted Second-Order Networks With Directed Topologies
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We consider consensus of multiweighted second-order networks with directed topologies. Multiweight means that the position state and velocity state have multiple inner coupling matrices (ICMs) and outer coupling matrices (OCMs) respectively. As far as we know, no research on second-order networks has studied multiweighted networks. To solve the problem of multiweighted networks, we utilize rearranging variables’ order technique (ROT). The key of ROT is taking the elements of ICMs as the coefficients of OCMs. Therefore, the information of ICMs can be made full use to reach consensus. Different from other studies on second-order networks, we consider both cooperative and competitive relationships between nodes and inside nodes. The corresponding numerical simulation verifies our theory.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Control of a Flexible Beam with Unknown Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper studies the model predictive control (MPC) problem for flexible cantilever beam nonlinear system subject to external disturbances. A cost function with exponential weight is designed to deal with this distributed parameter system. The feasibility of the conceived MPC method is analyzed. The results show that the vibration of the flexible beam system can be suppressed and the desired rotational angular velocity can be tracked effectively by the MPC controller under the proposed assumptions. Simulations are supplied to illustrate the utility of the designed controller.

articleTitle: Parallel Convolution and Attention for Pose Estimation
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Multi-scale feature fusion modules exhibit excellent performance in CNNs. However, these convolution modules suffer from inherent receptive field constraints for human pose estimation (HPE). Recently, transformer blocks have been introduced into HPE to exploit global information and capture correlations between different joints. But relying solely on the transformer block is insufficient and computationally expensive. We propose a parallel convolution and attention(PCA) module, which takes advantage of both local and global representations for efficient feature extraction. Furthermore, we propose a network based on the PCA module for HPE, termed PCApose. Experiments on MS-COCO demonstrate that, under comparable performance, PCApose reduces computation by half compared to Transpose [1]. Our model strikes a balance between computational burden and accuracy.

articleTitle: Online robust calibration/SLAM of multiple LiDARs with measurement noises
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the problem of robust simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) of a multi-LiDAR system with unknown extrinsic parameters. Our approach is mainly based on the theory of nonlinear Luenberger observers, which applies a linear stable transformation to the system’s measurement. Additionally, a computational strategy is employed to solve the SLAM problem for each LiDAR. Then extrinsic parameters are estimated online by a weighted least-square type adaptive identifier. Both the observer for SLAM and the identifier for calibration are robust against measurement noise in a standard input-to-state stability (ISS) frame.

articleTitle: Event-triggered sliding mode secure control for uncertain fractional-order CPSs against actuator attacks
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Fractional calculus is the generalization of the traditional integral calculus, which can describe the physical system more accurately. In this paper, we consider a sliding mode secure control problem for a class of uncertain fractional-order cyber-physical systems (CPSs) subject to actuator attacks. A sliding mode control method with a fractional-order adaptive super-twisting algorithm is designed to adjust the unknown bounds of the lumped uncertainties, and an event-triggering mechanism is proposed to save the system energy and resources. It is shown that, with the proposed secure control method, all the signals are guaranteed to converge to a small neighborhood of the origin. An example is given to demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: A Hybrid Integration Method for Low-Observable Micro-UAV Trajectory Tracking by 2D MIMO Radar
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: It is quite challenging for the micro-unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) which is in low-observable environments and has minor radar cross section (RCS) to detect and track. Accordingly, a hybrid method of coherent and noncoherent integration is proposed for micro-UAV tracking under poor signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) surroundings by 2-dimensional (2D) multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) radar with range, Doppler, azimuth and pitch. Firstly, for rectifying the range walk caused by long-term energy accumulation, this paper introduces keystone transform (KT) to eliminate the coupling terms of echo signals. On this foundation, for improving the detection and tracking performance of low-observable micro-UAV, the radar raw 4D measurements are directly utilized to integrate the detection and tracking processes aided by the track-before-detect (TBD) strategy, which avoids the information lack of weak targets caused by traditional tracking methods based on thresholds. Finally, simulation results indicate the approach in this paper corrects the range walk and has distinct superiorities over traditional approaches for trajectory tracking of micro-UAV under low SNR conditions.

articleTitle: A Less Conservative Criterion for Synchronization of Chaotic Lur’e System with Time-varying Delayed Feedback PD Control
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, the synchronization of time-varying delay Lur’e systems is investigated and a new Lyapunov-Krasovskii functional (LKF) based on the bound of time delay is constructed by considering the feature information of the time delay. Additionally, a modified free-matrix-based integral inequality (MFMBII) is applied to handle the derivatives from LKF in combination with more time-varying delayed data. By using the MFMBII, synchronization criterion with lower conservativeness is established. Finally, a Chua’s circuit is presented as numerical example to demonstrate the effectiveness and benefits of the proposed criterion.

articleTitle: Optimal PMU Placement and Fault Location Under Single PMU Failure
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Phasor measurement units (PMUs) are widely used in modern power system state estimation because of their high sampling rate that can estimate the power system state in real time. However, since PMUs are expensive to install, it is necessary to use a minimum number of PMUs to achieve a global observation of the system. In this paper, an improved nonlinear programming (NLP) method is proposed for the optimal PMU placement (OPP) problem under a single PMU fault, which incorporates a single PMU fault using a mathematical constraint. And for the multi-group solution problem of NLP, the method of total redundancy is introduced to find the optimum. Finally, the variation of the total redundancy of system observations under PMU faults and the phase sparsity property are used to locate the faulty PMU. Simulation tests are performed at IEEE 14-, 57- 118- bus, and the example results show that the proposed method is effective. In particular, the localization of individual PMU faults has 100% accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on MEMS Gyro Temperature Error Compensation Based on Variable Dynamic Conditions Experiment
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to analyze the effectiveness of the traditional temperature error compensation method of MEMS gyro under static condition and variable dynamic condition, this paper selected function fitting method and constant temperature control method to test the temperature error compensation effect of MEMS gyro under static condition and variable dynamic condition respectively. Firstly, the temperature error models of function fitting method and constant temperature control method are established, and the temperature error compensation effect is tested under static condition. Then, the temperature error compensation effect is tested under different variable dynamic conditions. Finally, by analyzing the source of error, it is determined that the error comes from the gyroscope itself and has nothing to do with the change of test conditions. The test results show that, in terms of temperature error compensation of MEMS gyro, the constant temperature control method and function fitting method have good compensation effect under static condition, but the compensation effect is insufficient under variable dynamic condition. Considering that MEMS gyro is mostly used under variable dynamic condition. More effective strategies are needed to improve the temperature error compensation effect of MEMS gyro under variable dynamic conditions.

articleTitle: A Modified Three-Dimensional Sliding Mode Guidance Law with Impact Angle Constraint
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes a modified three-dimensional (3D) impact angle constrained guidance law based on a sliding mode control approach. Firstly, sliding mode surfaces with respect to impact angles are designed in both yaw and pitch planes considering the 3D guidance characteristics. Then, a parameter adaptive power reaching law is designed based on Lyapunov stability theory. Furthermore, a modified sliding mode impact angle constrained guidance (SMIACG) law is deduced from the 3D guidance model via using the proposed sliding mode control technique. The modified 3D SMIACG law ensures finite-time convergence of the impact angle error rather than asymptotic or exponential convergence. Compared with existing 3D impact angle constrained guidance (IACG) methods, the deduced SMIACG law requires less maximum normal overload and less normal overload near the hit point while satisfying hitting accuracy. The trajectory is relatively straight in the final guidance process. Besides, the proposed guidance law processes a simple overall form without any switching strategy and only one parameter needs to be set which facilitates the practical application. Finally, various simulations under different scenarios are conducted to verify the properties and effectiveness of the modified SMIACG with further parameter setting suggestions.

articleTitle: Neural network-based adaptive sliding mode control for multi-joint manipulator
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Considering the problems of slow convergence speed and low tracking accuracy in the trajectory tracking control system of the multi-DOF manipulator, it is of great significance to design an effective control method to quickly track the target trajectories. In this paper, the dynamic modeling of the manipulator is conducted, followed by the development of a control strategy and an analysis of its stability. Firstly, the Lagrange method is applied to establish dynamic modeling of the manipulator. Secondly, a controller based on neural network adaptive sliding mode control is proposed to realize the trajectory tracking of the manipulator, which realizes the suppression of external disturbance and overcomes the influence of friction. Then, the Lyapunov direct method was applied to prove the stability of the designed system to guarantee the convergence of the tracking error. Finally, the experimental results based on Simulink under software Matlab indicate that the designed control strategy absolutely solve the problems of slow convergence speed and low tracking accuracy. It can adaptively compensate the uncertainties of the system and has good robustness against external interference.
