articleTitle: Cooperative path planning for USVs assembly task
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, with the gradual increase of human exploration and development of marine resources, unmanned surface vessel (USV) has shown great application prospects. In this paper, a distributed cooperative path planning method for USVs assembly task is proposed. First, a guidance vector field is constructed for local path planning based on the global path to guide USVs to avoid obstacles, and a reinforcement learning strategy is introduced for adaptive coefficient adjustment of the vector field. Then, the speed of each USV is regulated using the average consensus theory to satisfy the constraint of simultaneous arrival. Finally, simulation experiments are conducted to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Hybrid Fault-tolerant Control of Networked Control Systems based on Dynamic Event-triggered Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In paper, we study the issue of fault estimation and fault-tolerant control, for a series of linear networked control systems with arbitrary actuator failures under the dynamic event-triggered mechanism. Firstly, internal dynamic variable has been added to the event-triggered mechanism to further reduce waste in data transmission by expanding the interval between events. The closed-loop fault networked control systems are established under the dynamic event-triggered mechanism. Secondly, considering the influence of system errors on fault diagnosis, a fault detection observer is designed to detect faults online. Based on this, combining the merits of active and passive fault-tolerant control, a hybrid fault-tolerant controller is designed, which can effectively decrease the impact of unknown faults on system performance. Finally, a simulation example verifies the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: A Two-Stage Self-Training Framework for Nighttime Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Nighttime semantic segmentation is a challenging task due to the poor lighting in the night scenes. Since it is difficult to acquire pixel-level annotations of nighttime images, the existing works attempt to adapt a model learned on annotated daytime images to unlabeled nighttime images. Due to the gap between daytime and nighttime images, the model tends to over-fit daytime images and learn wrong annotation patterns for overexposed regions in nighttime images. To handle these issues, we propose a two-stage self-training framework, which synthesizes high-quality pseudo-labels for nighttime images based on overexposure detection. The synthetic pseudo-labels are then utilized as supervision information to retrain a new segmentation model, which significantly mitigates labeling errors in overexposed regions. Experiments on the DarkZurich dataset verify the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Output tracking control of the sine-Gordon model with unmatched general disturbance
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The output tracking problem of the sine-Gordon equation’s right endpoint is addressed in text research, taking into account both the input control and boundary perturbance at the same point is taken into account. Initially, we put forward a disturbance estimator of infinite order for it. The findings demonstrate that the constructed perturbance estimator is capable of accurately and rapidly gauging the boundary perturbance. Secondly, a servo system utilizing boundary disturbance estimation is built. Desired result about output monitoring the set signal has been accomplished. The sine-Gordon model, characterized by a group of partial differential equations, is the first time to apply unmatched performance output tracking control to completely suppress the general boundary perturbance and track the set signal meanwhile. The stability and the well-posedness of the system are analysed and guaranteed by Lyapunov function or Semigroups of operators. The proposed theoretical analysis results are finally verified through numerical experiments.

articleTitle: Energy efficiency evaluation method for public buildings based on energy efficiency improvement
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Systematic assessment of energy efficiency of power users in public buildings can help power users quickly determine the weak links of energy use and realize energy efficiency improvement calculation and modeling. However, mostly it is difficult to construct an objective evaluation system for public buildings due to the number and types of energy-consuming equipment for public buildings, the complexity of energy consumption and the wide range of social benefits. This paper proposed a set of comprehensive evaluation methods for energy efficiency of power users in public buildings. By analyzing the complex relationships among energy efficiency indexes, a comprehensive evaluation index system with multi-level and multi-dimensional characteristics is constructed from three aspects. At the same time, a TOPSIS-RSR energy efficiency evaluation model is proposed, which can solve the segmentation ordering of multi-user energy efficiency evaluation. By introducing entropy weight method to solve the problem of relying too much on the subjective experience of decision makers, the objective weight of each index is calculated, and the energy efficiency evaluation ranking of several similar users is given. Finally, 22 public buildings in a certain area are taken as examples to verify the rationality and feasibility of the proposed model and its superiority compared with other algorithms. The analysis shows that the evaluation results obtained by using this model can fully reflect the energy efficiency status of different power users, and provide an important basis for improving energy efficiency.

articleTitle: Design and Application of Magnetic Stimulator for Small Animals
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to study a magnetic stimulation device for small animals, which includes power supply module, charge-discharge circuit module, control system and stimulation coil. This device is small enough to be carried on small animals. It is powered by 12V rechargeable DC power supply, and the voltage regulator of BL8078 converts 12V to 3.3V to supply power for the single chip computer. In the experiment, the stimulator drived the stimulation coils placed on the head or leg of the animal to generate a time-varying magnetic field, which could generate an induced micro-current to deliver stimulation, and the leg EMG was synchronously recorded. Results showed that when the brain or leg sciatic nerve was stimulated by magnetic stimulator, the leg EMG was significantly strengthened. When the output frequency of the magnetic stimulation system was increased, the output current decreased, and the EMG enhancement response decreased. It shows that the magnetic stimulator can effectively regulate the function of brain and peripheral nerves by driving the stimulation coils.

articleTitle: Review of Home Energy Management Systems Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the development of distributed energy and smart grids, home energy management systems (HEMS) face challenges in coordinating and optimizing the management of multiple energy resources as an important part of the grid. Reinforcement learning (RL), as an interactive learning and decision-making method, has features such as adaptability, online performance, and model-free nature. It is suitable for solving problems such as uncertainty, dynamics and complexity in home energy systems. This article focuses on the current application status of RL in HEMS. It discusses the development trend and challenges of deep reinforcement learning (DRL) in this field and looks forward to future research directions.

articleTitle: A Loop Closure Detection SLAM System by Encoding Visual and Point Cloud Features
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Loop closure detection is a vital aspect of simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) and plays a very crucial role in minimizing cumulative mistakes. The hostile and unpredictable environment in which the robot operates makes it unfortunate that the original LIO-SAM technique for loop closure identification utilizing a single sensor is not always accurate. In this work, we describe how vision cameras and LiDAR can be merged. A novel global descriptor, visual scanning context (VSC), is proposed based on the fused data, which retains the geometric properties of the 3D spatial structure described by the visual features and the LiDAR information, and does not rely on training and odometry results, and can be used efficiently for location recognition. To improve the efficiency of retrieving candidate locations, an efficient two-layer search technique is suggested that is viewpoint-independent and rotationally invariant. The performance of our technology is tested and evaluated on publicly available datasets, and trials reveal that our system surpasses previous methods in terms of efficiency, accuracy, and robustness.

articleTitle: Birdsong Classification Based On Hybrid CNN-LSTM Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, wavelet packet denoising and data enhancement are used to deal with the problems of noisy background noise and small data volume in Birdsong Audio. The Mel frequency cepstral coefficients and Gammatone frequency cepstral coefficients extracted from the audio are fused to form a rich feature vector. In this paper, CNN and LSTM are combined to form a CNN-LSTM combined neural network model, which makes the network classification of birdsong more accurate.

articleTitle: Production prediction method of Industrial Process using LSTM neural network based on Snake Optimizer Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Ethylene production plays an important role in the petrochemical industry. Due to the high dimensionality of industrial data, the established data models are complex and contain a large number of hyperparameters. The selection of different hyperparameters of the neural network model has a great influence on the prediction accuracy. Therefore, a long short-term memory (LSTM) integrating Snake Optimizer algorithm (SOA) is proposed to achieve accurate prediction of ethylene production in complex chemical production processes. LSTM extracts the temporal dynamic interaction feature to predict ethylene production in a complex ethylene production process. Then, the SOA optimizes the hyperparameters of the LSTM as optimization variables including number of hidden layer nodes, batch size and training times, which can adaptively adjust the moving step size according to the current search state and target state of the solution vector. The root mean squared error (RMSE) is token as the optimization target of the SOA to obtain the global optimal solution of LSTM hyperparameters. Compared with back propagation (BP) neural network, extreme learning machine (ELM), and LSTM in the ethylene data, the SOA-LSTM achieve the state-of-the-art results. The RMSE, the MAPE and the MAE of SOA-LSTM are 4847.60, 4.10%, and 3593.54 respectively. Through the accurate prediction of ethylene production in the complex ethylene production process, its production efficiency can be effectively improved and carbon emissions can be reduced.

articleTitle: Fault Diagnosis of Central Air-Conditioning Chiller Based on AdaBoost-PSO-SVM
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To address the challenge that faults in central air-conditioning chillers are difficult to detect in time and the types of faults are easily misidentified, an ensemble fault diagnosis model based on AdaBoost-PSO-SVM is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the Support Vector Machine (SVM) model, which is widely applied to nonlinear problems, is chosen as the foundational model for fault diagnosis. Subsequently, the Particle Swarm Optimization algorithm (PSO) is used to find the best of the penalty factor C and the kernel parameter g of the SVM within a given range, resulting in the creation of the base learner PSO-SVM of the ensemble model. Finally, the AdaBoost-PSO-SVM fault diagnosis model integrates multiple PSO-SVM learners by updating the sample weights and assigning different weights to the base learners. The effectiveness of the proposed AdaBoost-PSO-SVM model is evaluated using experimental data from ASHRAE RP-1043. Results demonstrate its ability to accurately identify chiller faults, even including low severity levels, with an average diagnosis accuracy rate of 90.69%.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of Stochastic Aperiodic Sampled-data System based on Piecewise Technique
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Based on the piecewise technique, a new stability analysis strategy is proposed using stochastic sampled-data and loop-based functional methods. Suppose there are two sampled-data periods that satisfy the Bernoulli distribution. Two stochastic variables are given to describe the relationship between sampled-data period and delay. During the description of this article, a loop-based Lyapunov functional is created, which is completely considers the information within the intervals [t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k</inf>, t] and [t, t<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">k+1</inf>]. The stability analysis of aperiodic sampled-data is considered by the piecewise technique. The maximum sampled-data period increases with the increase of the number of piecewise. Finally, an example of a spring mass damper verifies the significance of the proposed control strategy.

articleTitle: A Novel Algorithm for Enhancing the Navigation Accuracy of INS/GNSS Integrated Systems in Urban Cities
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: For the inertial navigation system (INS)/ the global navigation satellite system (GNSS) integration, the stochastic error of the inertial sensor casts a significant influence on the overall positioning performance. Since stochastic error of inertial sensors generally has a quite complex structure, the classical estimation techniques including the Allan variance (AV) method, and the power spectral density (PSD) analysis suffer from the obvious drawbacks. However, a recently proposed estimator called the generalized method of wavelet moments (GMWM) is utilized to model the stochastic error for inertial sensors. Focused on the further improvement of GMWM and the design of the stochastic error model within the integrated navigation filter, a novel algorithm for enhancing the navigation accuracy of INS/GNSS integrated systems in urban cities is proposed. We performed a practical car experiments in urban areas to analyze the navigation solution of this novel algorithm. Then comparison with the AV-based method and the classical EKF method is further discussed. The results verified that the proposed novel algorithm can successfully enhance the navigation accuracy and implement the automatic modeling of the complicated stochastic errors.

articleTitle: Self-healing Control for Multi-input Multioutput Systems Based on a Fuzzy Neural Network Inverse Model
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Abnormal working conditions such as valve wear, pipeline leakage and environmental change often occur in modern industrial processes. According to a specific situation, abnormal working conditions are divided into three categories. In this paper, a self-healing controller that can automatically recover the key performance indicators of the whole system is designed to be utilized in some abnormal conditions that do not affect the safety of the system. On this basis, this paper proposes a self-healing controller based on fuzzy neural network inverse model. The controller obtains the historical data under normal operation status, and establishes a fuzzy neural network inverse model of a nonlinear multivariable process. The value of the adjustable variable in the industrial process is calculated through the real-time data collected, and then the adjustable variable is adjusted to return the key performance indicators of the entire system to the normal or close-to-normal level.

articleTitle: Boundary temperature identification of thermal equations based on boundary binary measurement information
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Based on the boundary binary sampling information of the heat equation, a support vector regression machine(SVR) algorithm is proposed. Given the problem that the SVR algorithm cannot actively select the optimal parameters, we use the particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm to optimize it. Besides, an improved PSO-SVR model is constructed to estimate the actual boundary value of the heat equation. The results show that the improved PSO-SVR model can effectively predict the boundary value of the heat equation. Also, the forecast accuracy is excellent, and the data collected can be used for more in-depth research.

articleTitle: Linear Quadratic Optimal Control of Stochastic Discrete-Time Systems with λ-Policy Iteration
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, an algorithm of λ-policy iteration is proposed to solve the linear quadratic regulator (LQR) problem for stochastic discrete-time systems. Firstly, an algebra Riccati equation (ARE) of the stochastic discrete-time systems is established. Then, the offline policy iteration (PI) and the offline value iteration (VI) are developed to solve the ARE. Based on the PI and the VI, the λ-policy iteration is applied to the LQR problem of stochastic discrete-time systems. In contrast to the PI, the initial stabilizing control policy is not required. Besides, the convergence speed is faster than the VI. Meanwhile, the convergence of the proposed λ-policy iteration is discussed. Finally, a simulation example is given to verify the effectiveness of the λ-policy iteration.

articleTitle: Trajectory tracking control for nonlinear high-order PDE system based on iterative learning method
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper addresses a trajectory tracking control method based on iterative learning for the nonlinear fourth-order partial differential equation (PDE) system. A noval iterative learning control law is designed that enables the repeatable Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation system track the desired trajectory. The Poincar'e-Wirtinger inequality and Cauchy-Schwartz inequality are applied to deal with the function problem in this paper. By using the Gronwall-Bellman lemma and integration by parts technique, a Lyapunov function is constructed and an LMI sufficient condition is provided, respectively. The effectiveness of the proposed iterative learning control method is verified through the convergence proof of the closed-loop Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equation system. Finally, the trajectory tracking curve simulation after multiple iterations is provied in this paper.

articleTitle: A Radar False Echo Signal Processing Method for Distance Measurement
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The effectiveness of millimeter-wave radar in anti-jamming and penetration has been demonstrated. This paper utilizes the Chirp-Z transform (CZT) spectral refinement algorithm to estimate range information. Additionally, an analysis and comparison of several FMCW radar echo signal processing algorithms for distance measurement is conducted. To improve the accuracy of distance measurement, multiple receivers are employed to determine the distance from the radar to the measured object or static interference object.

articleTitle: Design Method for Planner Coils under Magnetic Shielding Cylinder
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A novel strategy using the target field method (TFM) to design uniform and gradient magnetic field coils is proposed thereby addressing the coupling effect of magnetic field coils with high permeability materials. By combining the mirror method and Green’s function to solve the coupling effect between the magnetic field generated by the coil of the cylindrical structure and the externally enclosed high permeability material, the magnetic field generated on the inner surface of the magnetic shield and on the boundary of the magnetic field coil is finally calculated accurately.
