The proposed design strategy is validated by simulation analysis, and the research methodology of this strategy can be further applied to the development of core apparatus for magnetic field regulation and compensation of atomic sensors.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning Approach of Mobile Robot based on A*-SPF in Complex Environment
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Path planning is a hot topic in mobile robots. The path, which planned by A* algorithm, is not smooth. The distance of the path is long, and the fault tolerance of the path is low. Meanwhile, due to the local unknown environments in the global environment, the mobile robot is prone to deviate from the planned path when autonomous navigation is performing. Therefore, the influence of local unknown environments is considered, and a novel path planning approach, which based on A*-SPF, is proposed in this paper. Firstly, according to the unequal rules of environmental information, an improved A* algorithm is proposed by modifying the cost function. Secondly, by integrating a simulated potential field (SPF), a path correction algorithm is proposed, by which the mobile robot can move close to the optimal path. The proposed approach is compared and analyzed in simulation experiments. The results of the experiments demonstrate that the path planned by the proposed approach is accurate. The tracking path is close to the optimal path. The robustness to different environments is also achieved.

articleTitle: An electrical control training device and its control method
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this article, an electrical control training device which consists of an electric box, moving components, arranging components, dust suction components and payoff components is designed. The design of moving components which designed with sliding rod and adaptive spring can realize the fast connection operation of each electrical element in the electric box. The design of arranging components which designed with large , small placement boxes and curved sliding roller can reduce the friction damage of the wire in the process of traversing, and make the wires line up.In addition, dust suction components is designed to prevent the dust inside the electrical box from polluting the wiring of the electrical components and to ensure that the wiring of the electrical components can be normally energized. The design further improves the value of the practical training device.

articleTitle: Stereo Vision-Based Motion Estimation for Space Point Targets
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of accuracy improvement for the motion estimation of space point targets in the early detection stage from high-orbit infrared remote sensing satellites. Firstly, according to the imaging characteristics of the high-orbit satellite, the paper establishes the imaging mapping models and obtains the simulated images as the inputs. Then, the three-dimensional position recovery equations of the target are constituted through the relationship of imaging mapping models between two satellites. Next, the target trajectory is fitted by cubic spline interpolation, and a differential algorithm solves the target velocities. Finally, considering line-of-sight (LOS) measurement error in actual observation, the Savitzky-Golay filter is used to smooth the estimated target positions and velocities. Simulation results show that the proposed method has an obvious advantage over the extended Kalman filter (EKF) method in real-time tracking accuracy at an early target detection stage under the same design parameters and errors.

articleTitle: Augmented reality-based accurate teaching system and method for industrial robots
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of cumbersome and low efficiency in the teaching process of the existing industrial robot by using the teaching box, this paper establishes an accurate teaching system for industrial robots based on augmented reality and conducts algorithmic research on the 3D tracking registration, motion simulation, and hand recognition technologies of this system. First, the 3D registration method based on multiple markers is proposed to improve the accuracy of virtual object registration in real space, then the robot forward and inverse solution algorithms are elaborated and applied to the motion simulation and online control process of the virtual industrial robot; finally, the Mediapipe open source deep learning network model is applied to hand interaction to achieve immersive human-robot interaction. Experimental results show that this method can achieve an average trajectory accuracy of 1.05mm and a maximum trajectory accuracy of 2.24mm, meeting the accuracy requirements of robot welding and spraying applications.

articleTitle: Backstepping Design for Circular Formation Control of Dynamic Nonholonomic Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper explores the problem of distributed circular formation control for networked dynamic nonholonomic vehicles. The topology among the networked vehicles is described by a directed graph. A backstepping-based distributed control law, which requires each vehicle to use local measurement and communication, is proposed for the kinematic and dynamic models of nonholonomic vehicles. The study demonstrates that all vehicles can achieve global convergence to a predetermined circular trajectory while revolving around the target. Furthermore, they can also globally converge to a desired formation with appropriate spacing along the circular path. Finally, a simulation example is presented to illustrate the result.

articleTitle: Fixed-Time Impact Time Control Guidance Law for Missiles With Input Saturation Constraints Against Maneuvering Targets
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the fixed-time impact time control guidance (ITCG) problem against maneuvering targets. Firstly, the fixed-time observers are adopted to estimate the maneuvering target’s unknown acceleration. Then, a fixed-time ITCG law is derived by resorting to the time-to-go of deviated pursuit guidance, where the unknown target acceleration is compensated based on the estimates obtained from the fixed-time observers. Moreover, an auxiliary system is adopted to tackle the frequently encountered input saturation constraints, and the fixed-time stability of the proposed ITCG law is analyzed. Finally, simulation results are provided to demonstrate the designed ITCG law.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Impulsive Control for Nonlinear Systems under Input Saturation
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: We investigates the event-triggered impulsive control (ETIC) problem for nonlinear systems subject to input saturation. To reduce the number of impulsive control, the event-triggered mechanism (ETM) is employed to generate impulsive control instants. To address the input saturation, the polytopic representation approach is adopted. By the proposed ETIC scheme, LMI-based conditions are derived to ensure the local exponential stability (LES) of the impulsive control system. The domain of attraction is estimated by solving a optimization problem. The effectiveness of ETIC scheme is shown by an example of Chua’s circuits.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Fuzzy Sliding Mode Control for Power-Line Inspection Robot
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper presents a fuzzy sliding mode control for a power line inspection(PLI) robot to accomplish a power line investigation robot hostile to impedance balance control. The PLI robot, right off the bat, is linearised at the balance point. In light of the linearised PLI robot model, the T-S model of the PLI robot is planned considering obscure bothers and dependability examination is completed. Also, the control contribution to the framework is obtained by making the slipform surface. The shut circle framework is examined to verify that the framework is fixed-time stable and enjoys the benefits of quick combination and high following exactness. The most excellent intermingling time is acquired.

articleTitle: Deep Learning based Dynamic-to-Static Image Translation for Accurate Localization of Autonomous Driving Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Simultaneous localization and mapping is widely used for real-time localization of autonomous vehicles when GPS signals are not available. However, the presence of dynamic objects in the city can lead to the introduction of incorrect feature matching pairs, resulting in degradation of localization accuracy. To tackle this challenge, we focus on dynamic-to-static image translation, aiming to recover static images from dynamic scenes and reduce the negative effect of dynamic elements. We achieve this by proposing a semantic-guided dynamic-to-static image translation model. It recovers static semantic segmentation maps from the dynamic image and then leverages the encoded semantic feature maps to guide the generation of static images, making the model more focused on semantic information. Specifically, in this paper, we first segment the images semantically and then fuse the up-sampling layer of the semantic segmentation network with the down-sampling layer of the dynamic-static translation model. Experiments show that the model can better perform the task of dynamic scene translation and help unmanned vehicles to achieve accurate navigation and positioning based on vSLAM.

articleTitle: Cap-CasMVSNet:Capsul-based Cascade Cost Volume for Multi-View Stereo Network
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Currently deep learning has been widely used in multi-view stereo, but there is still room for optimization. In this paper, we propose a capsule network-based multi-view stereo network, namely Cap-CasMVSNet. We first introduce a transformer-based filter to highlight the foreground part of the feature. Then aiming at the shortcomings of the fixed receptive field of the traditional convolution kernel, we added a deformable convolution module to the network to enable the convolution to adapt to geometric deformation. We use a capsule neuron to handle global semantic connections between high-level features. Finally, we achieve competitive results on the DTU dataset, showing strong robustness.

articleTitle: Extreme Learning Machine Classifier Based on Novel Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low classification accuracy caused by random input weights and hidden layer bias in ELM (Extreme Learning Machines, ELM), a method based on IPSO (Improved Particle Swarm Optimization, IPSO) to optimize the network classification model of Extreme Learning Machines is proposed. Firstly, the nonlinear inertia weight and dynamic acceleration factor are used to balance the exploration and mining of the PSO algorithm; Secondly, the variables of the ELM model are enhanced by IPSO to reduce the influence caused by strong volatility; Finally, simulation results show that compared with SVM, ELM, GA-ELM, IPSO-ELM could effectively improve the precision of classification prediction.

articleTitle: ECT: Enhancement Cross Training for Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In recent years, Weakly Supervised Semantic Segmentation (WSSS) has garnered significant attention, as it enables pixel-level segmentation using only image-level labels. However, current WSSS methods typically rely on extracting Class Activation Map (CAM) from a classification network as the initial localization cues, which are often narrow and fragmented. In this paper, we demonstrate that more regions can be activated by roughly applying enhancement functions on CAM. Specifically, we propose an Enhancement Cross Training (ECT) approach for WSSS, which involves non-learning enhancement functions and a Cross Training process for integrating enhancement functions into the learnable CAM generation network. By cross-training two identical CAM generation models, ECT allows CAM to expand with its own localization information. Experiment on PASCAL VOC 2012 shows that our method is competitive with existing state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: Intelligent measurement method of aircraft leading edge slats based on vision
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The safety performance of civil aircraft is closely related to the reliability of aircraft slat mechanism, and the slat failures of civil aircraft have been occurring continuously in recent years. The design of aircraft slats has a great impact on the resistance during flight. The relative chord displacement of slats and main wings cannot be ignored, which has a great impact on aircraft resistance. In order to accurately and quantitatively obtain the relative displacement of the leading edge slat and the main wing of the aircraft, this paper adopts the combined measurement method of stereo intersection photogrammetry and relay measurement, and designs a multi-target real-time tracking algorithm based on the YOLO Tiny algorithm and the Kernel Correlation Filter (KCF) algorithm, which can accurately and quantitatively measure the change of the leading edge of the slat, At the same time, the variation trend of the measured results also conforms to the variation trend of the leading edge slats during the movement process.

articleTitle: Fusion of UNet and Criminisi algorithms for endoscopic specular highlight removal
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To address the problems of incomplete highlight segmentation and unreasonable repair texture in the current endoscope specular highlight removal algorithm, a fusion of UNet and Criminisi is proposed for the endoscope specular highlight removal algorithm. Highlight removal is mainly divided into two processes: highlight segmentation and inpainting. In the highlight segmentation module, the highlights are segmented based on the improved UNet model in combination with the transfer learning strategy. Firstly, VGG16 is used as the backbone feature extraction network; secondly, in the enhanced feature extraction module, a simple pyramid pooling module is used to aggregate global contextual information to improve the network's ability to obtain global information; finally, we trained the model using a loss function that mixes dice loss and focus loss. In the highlight inpainting module, the Criminisi algorithm with a better reconstruction effect is chosen and the original priority function is optimized to improve the algorithm. The experimental results show that in the highlight segmentation module, the Dice coefficient and IoU of the improved algorithm are improved by 0.97% and 1.37%, respectively; in the highlight inpainting module, the PSRN and SSIM values of the improved algorithm are improved by 0.78 dB and 0.005, respectively, which verifies the effectiveness and feasibility of the improved algorithm and has certain clinical application potential.

articleTitle: Self-Supervised Learning Denoising Network For Intelligent Fault Diagnosis With Limited Labeled Data
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: While supervised learning has received tremendous attentions in many real applications due to its successful use of huge labeled data, in fault diagnosis it is impossible to obtain enough labeled fault data samples under each operating condition for training deep learning models. To address the issue of limited labeled data, we propose a few-shot learning approach for efficient fault diagnosis, which is referred to as Denoising Simple Siamese (DNSS). The proposed DNSS involves a denoising module that effectively integrates soft thresholding and deep learning techniques, leading to exceptional performance in noise reduction, feature extraction, and fault identification. We conducted extensive experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of DNSS under various noise conditions and with varying amounts of labeled and unlabeled data. The experimental results demonstrate that DNSS can maintain high diagnostic accuracy with limited labeled data under a wide range of operating conditions.

articleTitle: Online Compensation Method of Infrared Temperature Measurement Error Based on Fusion of Infrared Vision and Visible Light Vision
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Infrared thermography is a widely used non-contact temperature measurement method, but the water mist on the optical path will seriously interfere with the infrared temperature measurement results. Aiming at the interference caused by the water mist, an online compensation method of infrared temperature measurement error is proposed based on multi-source visual fusion. Firstly, considering that water mist will reduce transmittance and scatter infrared radiation, a compensation model is established based on the infrared temperature measurement principle. Secondly, the scattering effect of water mist is quantified by merging the multi-scale infrared thermal image after guided filtering. Subsequently, the water mist transmittance in the visible light waveband is estimated online by visible light image, and then is corrected to be the water mist transmittance in the infrared waveband. Finally, temperature measurement experiments are carried out under the influence of water mist. The experimental results show that the proposed method can effectively reduce the infrared temperature measurement error caused by water mist.

articleTitle: Distributed Recursive Filtering for Time-Varying System with Multiplicative Noise under Stochastic Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper is concerned with the distributed recursive filtering problem for a class of linear discrete-time stochastic systems subject to the effect of time delay, multiplicative noise and stochastic protocol. In order to regulate communication between nodes, each node receives data from only one of its adjacent nodes at each communication moment by a stochastic protocol. The aim of the proposed filtering problem is to construct a Kalman-type filter so that the upper bound of the filtering error covariance is minimized by designing appropriate filter parameters. Moreover, a sufficient condition is proposed by utilizing mathematical induction, which is used to determine the boundedness of error covariance. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed filtering scheme.

articleTitle: UUV mission re-planning based on threat assessment of uncertain events
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The mission planning of unmanned underwater vehicles (UUV) is directly related to the efficiency of underwater operations. Given the complexity of the subseafloor environment and the frequency of uncertain events, in some cases, UUV has difficulty accomplishing its mission as originally intended. Intended for the UUV mission planning problem, a mission reprogramming strategy based on the assessment of uncertain event threats is proposed. The first is UUV based on the distribution of initial task planning, using the self-organizing network algorithm for UUV scheduling access to multiple task points in the temporal, sequence and the shortest path to task points. The second is to determine the type of uncertain event that occurs during a UUV mission and turn it into a Bayesian network. The final step is to use the Bayesian network to assess the threat level of uncertain events. When the threat level, is greater than the threshold, UUV performs mission reprogramming; If not, UUV will, continue its mission as originally planned. Overall, the results show that the proposed algorithm can guarantee the security of the UUV operation and improve the completion rate.

articleTitle: Time-varying group formation tracking for UAV swarm systems with collision avoidance
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the tracking and control problem of UAV swarm formation, it has important application value in civil fields such as environmental monitoring, disaster rescue, regional logistics Based on the consensus control theory, this paper proposes an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) group formation tracking control method with a collision avoidance mechanism. The designed control approach is verified on the Matlab simulation platform respectively. A physical verification is built by using motion capture as external positioning system, and the physical flight of the Tello UAV swam system is carried out. The results verify the effectiveness of the designed UAV group formation tracking control method with a collision avoidance mechanism.

articleTitle: Control of Servo Systems Based on Differentiable Lugre Friction Model
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of high-precision tracking control of servos with nonlinear friction compensation. Although friction compensation based on the LuGre model has been widely applied in various industrial servo mechanisms, combining it with inverse design is challenging due to the piecewise continuous characteristics of the model. As a result, servo control based on nonlinear models rarely involves friction compensation for non-differentiable friction models such as the LuGre model and the Stribeck effect. This study introduces an enhanced particle swarm approach to adapt the conventional piecewise continuous LuGre model, leading to the development of a novel model, which is both nonlinear and continuously differentiable. Then it introduce an adaptive inverse controller that takes into account factors such as friction parameters and transmission clearance in the established nonlinear servo system. By means of Lyapunov analysis, the controller provides a theoretical assurance of asymptotic tracking performance even in the presence of parameter uncertainties, while also demonstrating robustness against unconsidered dynamics and external disturbances. The simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed controller. This research provides a new approach to nonlinear friction compensation and control of servo systems, with potential applications in various industries.

articleTitle: Smart Recommendation of Cloud Music Services Based on Contextualized Mentality Modeling and Beyond
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Cloud music services have gained immense popularity as internet applications. However, the vast array of music products available on cloud platforms presents a challenge for users seeking to swiftly and accurately discover their desired music. Furthermore, the emotional and psychological preferences of listeners, as well as their mood in varying environmental contexts, significantly influence their artistic experience with music. Consequently, there is a pressing need to develop a music recommendation system within cloud music services that enhances search efficiency and accuracy. This paper proposes an intelligent recommendation approach that leverages preference modeling and context sensing to deliver precise recommendations. Initially, a neural experiment is conducted to analyze customer satisfaction with the cloud music service. Building upon this, a mental model is introduced, which captures users' psychological preferences and music preferences. Finally, we present a smart recommendation method that integrates emotional and rational intelligence for cloud music services. Experimental results demonstrate the satisfactory and effective assistance provided by our approach in helping customers discover music aligned with their preferences.

articleTitle: Network topology and bandwidth optimization for communication enhancement of multi-UAV system
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: UAV communication network is an important supplement to traditional ground communication networks. The deployment optimization of the UAV communication network has the characteristics of diverse performance requirements, complex users’ requirement on ground, and strong node mobility. Therefore, given the above characteristics, we consider the network topology optimization problem of multi-UAV system to enhance its communication capability. We make the following contributions: Firstly, considering user coverage, link load, and link stability, a multi-objective optimization measurement model is established. Secondly, due to the different communication requirements and bandwidth of the users in each area, we introduce Optimized Link State Routing(OLSR) strategy to ensure the reliability of information transmission. Thirdly, the existence of multiple communication performance optimization indicators in the UAV network leads a higher dimension of the multi-objective optimization problem, bringing greater convergence pressure to the entire algorithm. We introduce chaotic sequences to improve the Non-dominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm-II(NSGA-II) to retain more good solution sets and ease the convergence pressure of the whole algorithm. The effectiveness of the proposed optimization strategy and improved NSGA-II algorithm is verified by numerical experiment.

articleTitle: Robust LiDAR-Visual-Inertial Fusion Odometry for Autonomous Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Robust and accurate self-motion estimation is important for safe driving of autonomous vehicle. Aiming at this goal, in this paper, we propose a convenient multi-sensor fusion odometry framework that integrates lidar, vision and inertial sensors. As the basis of the fusion system, stereo visual odometry and lidar inertial odometry are also designed. At the same time, observability and measurement consistency checking methods are proposed for sensor failure detection and effective sensor fusion. The proposed multi-sensor fusion odometry can ensure the continuity of self-motion estimation in the event of a single-sensor estimation fails, and improves the accuracy of single-sensor odometry, which has been demonstrated in a series of real-world experiments.

articleTitle: Epilepsy Analysis with Portable Device based Multi-modal Physiological Signals
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Portable devices have been widely studied in epilepsy detection, but few epilepsy analyses using wristband based multi-modal physiological signals are reported. In this paper, multimodal physiological signals of acceleration (ACC), gyroscope (GYR), electromyography (EMG), and electrodermal skin (EDA) recorded by a wistband from 36 childhood epilepsy subjects from the Children's Hospital, Zhejiang University School of Medicine (CHZU) are involved for study. The significance of multi-modal physiological signal features in characterizing epilepsy seizure onset is carried out based on statistical analysis and feature correlation. Discriminative feature selection based on the Statistical Analysis is applied for feature reduction. Studies reveal that: 1) using single-modal physiological signal either by ACC, GYR ,EMG, or EDA can offer a satisfactory seizure detection performance, where the highest sensitivity by singlemodal physiological signal is 78.22%, 2) using multi-modal physiological signals can improve the detection sensitivity to 84.16%, 3) using discriminative feature selection on multi-modal physiological signals can further enhance the seizure detection accuracy to 88.16%.

articleTitle: Distributed Prescribed-Time Containment Tracking for Heterogeneous Linear Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The problem of distributed prescribed-time containment tracking in heterogeneous multi-agent systems is investigated in the study. Herein, prescribed-time refers to the ability to set the stabilization time offline and not affected by any initial parameters. Using the Pontryagin maximum principle, the continuous-time tracking control problem is transformed into a multi-step motion planning problem. Utilizing this framework, a distributed control protocol based on relative sampling measurement information is developed. With the sampling time series, the designed protocol solves the prescribed-time containment tracking problem in heterogeneous linear multi-agent systems. Finally, the effectiveness of the theoretical approach is validated.

articleTitle: Visual-Based Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robot Grasping with Pushing
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Robot grasping is a hot topic in the field of intelligent robot. The synergistic effect of robot grasping and pushing is of great help to manipulation tasks of robots. Someone proposed a model-free grasping method for robot based on deep reinforcement learning combined with a pushing and grasping network, which can determine action choices in pushing and grasping based on visual scene states and then obtain rewards. The network was trained through trial and error. Based on this method, we improve the model by adding feature fusion module and attention module to the deep Q-network, and train and test it in a simulated environment. The experiments show that our model has significantly improved grasping success rate and efficiency. Moreover, in complex unknown environments, the grasping performance of our model is also better than that of the original model.

articleTitle: Client-based differential privacy federated learning
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Deep learning provides better personalized services by training specific models through massive amounts of data. However, due to the problem of gradient leakage during model training, the original data uploaded by the users is restored and privacy leakage occurs. In order to prevent data leakage, this paper introduces a federated learning method to deal with the privacy issues brought by multi-user joint modeling. Gradients generated by the user’s local model training are uploaded to the aggregation server without being trained directly using the original user data. Under such a framework setting, the users’ original data still has a certain risk of being leaked. In order to strengthen the protection of users’ privacy, the training process is encrypted by combining the differential privacy mechanism and the federated learning system. The model parameters are stochastic to ensure that they cannot be acquired by adversaries. By adding Gaussian mechanism and Laplace mechanism, the influence of differential privacy on the convergence of federated learning model is analyzed. The Laplace mechanism is a strict definition of differential privacy, while the Gaussian mechanism is a relaxed definition and allows adding less noise for privacy protection. The simulation results show that both mechanisms can achieve good model convergence effect and verify that differential privacy can produce better privacy protection effect with lower communication cost.

articleTitle: Prediction model for hot metal temperature based on MI-PSO-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the development of artificial intelligence, digital empowerment to help the intelligent transformation of blast furnaces and achieve the "30-60" target has become a major research objective. As one of the important indicators of blast furnace production, the reasonable prediction for hot metal temperature could help to master the operating status of furnace conditions and reduce the energy consumption in time. Therefore, a molten iron temperature model based on PSO-LSTM is proposed in this paper. Firstly, for the characteristics of blast furnace data such as long time lag and the abnormal values difficultly judge, the handling for sample data is completed by using the big data method. Secondly, the selection for parameters based on the complementary of process and big data techniques is used to improve the interpretation of model input variables. Finally, a PSO-LSTM prediction model was established by the LSTM algorithm, and the prediction capability is analysed from four perspectives include mean absolute error (MAE) and root mean square error (RMSE) and so on. The results show that the prediction accuracy of hot metal temperature is up to 95.6%, which has certain implications for production guidance.

articleTitle: Research And Application of Intelligent Construction of Large Span Power Engineering Based on 3D Model
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Combined with the General Requirement of "Digital national net work"and the concept of "Ubiquitous power internet of things", digital construction and intelligent sensing technology are introduced into the construction of power transmission and transformation projects. Relying on the fifth passage project of Jiangsu Province, through BIM fine modeling, solving the design drawing inspection of super-high Tower, construction scheme simulation; through finite element analysis, combined with intelligent sensing system, on-line monitoring of the construction site, provide technical support for construction process safety. The key technology of intelligent acceptance is studied by laser point cloud 3d imaging of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), and the assistant intelligent acceptance of transmission tower and transmission line is realized. In the aspect of quality and safety control based on 3D, from the material of Super High Tower to the on-the-spot self-developed mobile phone end + PC end linkage based on 3D visualization, the automatic quality control of Steel Tower Coating (primer, intermediate paint, topcoat, etc.) is one of the innovations of the project based on 3D quality control technology. The application of the development result "Intelligent management platform of transmission and distribution engineering based on three-dimensional model" in the large-span project, realizes the Quality Safety Control based on visualization for the super-high tower, the monitoring and control system of Beidou deformation, which uses sensors based on the Internet of things technology and solar energy with its own power supply system, has improved the automatic management level of tower quality and the inspection efficiency of quality inspectors during the construction of super-high towers, the wireless automatic safety monitoring of the super-high tower based on the Internet of things has been realized, and the problems of the super-high tower being unable to be wired, power supply being difficult, signal transmission system being stable and so on have been solved, and the monitoring data have been effectively managed and applied, to the spot construction risk plays the prompt early warning function. The ultra-high Tower Adopts Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) to fly on its own to collect the data of laser point cloud, which realizes the assistant quality inspection and acceptance of the tower, the automatic inspection of the data of point cloud measurement and the defects based on image recognition technology, the actual application effect is obvious, the project implementation also has the reference value to the later other projects, has the significant promotion value to the actual construction.

articleTitle: A Novel Sparrow Search Algorithm for Microgrid Optimal Scheduling with Electric Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, a new improved sparrow search algorithm (ISSA) based on the swarm-intelligence technique method is proposed for the optimal scheduling problem of the microgrid (MG) model with electric vehicles (EVs). In order to make a better reasonable scheduling plan for the power generation plan of each power source on the MG, the ISSA is used to optimize the power distribution. Two strategies are used to improve the basic SSA. One is replace the producer update formula with the fractional particle swarm position update formula, and it can enhance the searching ability of the ISSA. The other one is multi-producer following strategy, which can better balance the global exploration and local exploitation of the ISSA. The effectiveness of the ISSA is verified via some well-known benchmark functions. The experimental results demonstrate that the ISSA performs better compared to other algorithms. Finally, the ISSA is successfully applied to a MG model based on two EV charge-discharge control strategies.

articleTitle: Filling Deterministic Approximate Gap in Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models with Energy
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Diffusion probabilistic models (DPMs) have shown the best generative quality and admit impressive likelihood meanwhile. However, its variants take very long generative processes during sampling, because of the small noise scale assumption, say, sets the variance of the forward diffusion kernel to be very small. Under which, the generative denoising processes are of tractable Gaussian form. To shorten the generative process, we explore the non-Gaussian reverse kernel under the large noise scale assumption and analysis the deterministic approximate gap of Gaussian denoising process. To fill the gap, we enhance the standard DPM with conditional energy and introduce variantional sampler to construct tractable generative process. The new probabilistic model, termed denoising diffusion energy-based model (DDEBM), are trained with two stage adversarial optimization. Experiments show our models demonstrate competitive generative performance with only four steps.

articleTitle: Feature Classification of Motor Imagery EEG Based on Deep Learning Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The Brain Computer Interface (BCI) technology refers to not rely on normal brain nerve and musclar tissue, but on computer or other equipment to build a new information transmission circuit between the brain and the external environment, it can directly realize the information exchange between brain and external environment, which is a new way for human to communicate with the outside world. Motor imagery brain-computer interfaces are increasingly being used in practical application scenarios where the degree of accuracy in classification is crucial. However, due to the small amount of data available for MI EEG, overfitting can easily occur when using deep learning network models for classification training, resulting in low recognition rates. To overcome this problem, we have proposed, attention mechanismc convolutional neural network (AMCNN) which is a novel optimized convolution neural network model. A 4-Layer convolutional neural network is built as the classifier and convolutional kernels of different sizes are applied. The performance obtained by the proposed approach is evaluated by Accuracy, Precision, Recall and Kappa value. The accuracy on dataset 2a from competition IV(BCIIV-2a) reaches 86%, and the best Precision, Kappa and Recall on dataset 2a from competition IV is greater than many of other methods.

articleTitle: Improving Communication Efficiency: A Dual Adaptive Federated Learning Framework
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: As internet technology continues to advance, there is a growing recognition of the significance of safeguarding data privacy. Federated Learning (FL) has emerged as a noteworthy approach for preserving data privacy. Nevertheless, a common challenge in FL is the non-Independently and Identically Distributed (non-IID) nature of the data. This can lead to a misalignment between the optimal solution achieved by each client and the globally optimal solution. The client drift problem greatly reduces the convergence rate and communication efficiency of FL. This paper introduces a dual adaptive FL framework (FedDA) to achieve efficient communication for FL. During client training, FedDA uses adaptive temporal correction factors to alleviate client drift and avoid optimizing towards local optima, thereby improving model training quality and convergence rate. During server aggregation, FedDA uses a forward-looking adaptive optimization algorithm to accelerate global model aggregation, resulting in enhanced communication efficiency achieved through a reduction in the requisite number of communication rounds for model convergence. Extensive experimentation across various datasets validates that the introduced FedDA can significantly accelerate model convergence, improve model communication efficiency, and exhibit robustness to different FL settings.

articleTitle: Research on Arrhythmia Identification Method based on Wrist Radial Pulse Wave
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Arrhythmias can cause abnormalities in the radial pulse wave of the patient’s wrist. In this paper, the differences between arrhythmia pulse wave and healthy pulse wave in morphology, spectrum and wavelet energy are analyzed. We use the mean period (MT) of the pulse wave, the standard deviation of the period (MST), the harmonic frequency (f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>), the harmonic amplitude (fp<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>), the spectral energy ratio (sen), the -wavelet energy (E<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">i</inf>), and the -wavelet entropy (WE) as the features of the pulse wave, and the support vector machine was used to classify the arrhythmia pulse wave and the healthy pulse wave. The results show that when three feature combinations of morphological features (MF), spectral features (SF), and -wavelet energy features (WF) are selected, the performance of the classifier is the best, and the accuracy rate is 95.18%, and the corresponding sensitivity is 96.08%, specificity was 93.75%, F1_scor was 0.9608, and AUC value was 0.9871. The research results show that the three characteristics of MF, SF, and WF can be used as objective indicators to distinguish arrhythmia pulse wave from healthy pulse wave. Combined -with machine learning method, it provides a new auxiliary evaluation index for clinical diagnosis of arrhythmia. The method of arrhythmia identification by pulse wave is feasible.

articleTitle: Monocular vision-based correction method for the position of robot screw nail
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the process of satellite assembly, there are errors in the installation and positioning of the cabin board and the frame, which leads to the deviation between the position of the screw screwed by the teaching robot and the actual position of the screw hole. In order to solve this problem, a method of robot screw position and orientation correction based on monocular vision is proposed. The Eye-in-Hand structure was used to capture images online by monocular camera. After filtering and denoising the images, the Canny operator was used to extract the feature contour of nail holes. In view of the fracture of the nail hole feature contour, a fracture contour similarity splicing algorithm was proposed, so as to retain the original information of the nail hole more comprehensively. The image was upgraded to the sub-pixel level, and the position of nail holes in the image was extracted with high precision through sub-pixel edge detection. The homologous relation between the actual image and the desired image is calculated to estimate the pose of the robot when taking the desired image. According to the prior relationship between the desired pose when the robot takes a picture and the desired pose when the robot tightens the screws, the actual robot's tightening screw position was corrected. The deviation threshold of the image and the error threshold of the robot kinematics were set, and then the correction times of the position of the screw tightened by the robot were constrained. Finally, the experimental results show that the proposed method can meet the accuracy requirements of robot screw nails in the satellite assembly process.

articleTitle: Review of research on ”Quality Optimization Control of Cement Vertical Grinding”
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In view of the current situation of narrow cement particle size distribution and low efficiency in the vertical grinding process of new dry cement production process, the research and application dynamics of online cement quality detection, internal pressure difference optimization setting and modeling and control of the vertical grinding process of cement were analyzed, and the neural network algorithm was proposed to establish the vertical grinding process model of cement. The proportion integration differentiation (PID) control, fuzzy control, model predictive control and their combined control algorithms were summarized. In order to improve the grinding quality of cement vertical grinding powder, the feasibility of each method was analyzed. Finally, it is demonstrated that the proportional integral-generalized predictive control (PI-GPC) control method is used to achieve better control effect, which is conducive to solving the problem of narrow cement size distribution and improving cement quality.

articleTitle: Cooperative Guidance Law Based on Cover Penetration in Two-on-two Engagement
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the two-on-two interception engagement scenario, a cooperative penetration guidance method based on cover strategy is proposed. This method is used to head-on intercept situations where the speed and maneuverability of the opposing sides are close. A team comprised of defender and penetration missile lure the two interceptors and damage them. Firstly, the application scenarios and assumptions of the strategy are introduced, and the kinematic equation are given to describe the penetration process. The optimal control problem is established and solved using sequential convex optimization method. In addition, a continuously optimal guidance law based on receding horizon policy is proposed to deal with the uncertainty and observation error of enemy. The effectiveness of the method are verified by numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Combined Control Ability of Stratospheric Balloon Phase Change Gasbag and Auxiliary Gasbag
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The stratospheric high-altitude balloon is an unpowered aircraft that relies on the lifting gas and is mainly affected by high-altitude thermal characteristics. In most cases, high-altitude balloons use a single gasbag structure, which is filled with the lifting gas to gain buoyancy and fly high in the air. Google added an air gasbag inside the main gasbag to improve auxiliary flight and achieved favorable flight results. The triple-gasbag aerostat is a single air gasbag that adds an air gasbag and a phase change gasbag,respectively, relying on the gas-liquid phase change system and air pump to adjust the size of the phase change gasbag and air gasbag. Through the analysis of stratospheric altitude direction dynamics and thermodynamic characteristics, a coupled mathematical model is established, and data simulation is carried out. In the control system, the combination of gas-liquid phase change and air exchange is used to analyze the influence of solar radiation on the pressure and height changes caused by the heating and cooling of the gasbag under different gas liquefaction rates, in order to avoid super-pressure and super-heat and maintain a stable flight state. At the same time, energy consumption needs to be considered to obtain the maximum control effect on the pressure difference, thereby achieving flight at an altitude of about 20km at mid or low latitudes.

articleTitle: Position Estimation for Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUV) Docking Based on Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) docking technology is currently a hot topic in underwater robot research, and precise and reliable navigation is a key technology for AUV docking. Position problem is key for the AUV docking, which is solved by fusing information from different sensors, such as the nertial navigation (INS) and the ultra-short baseline positioning system (USBL). The Kalman filter is a conventional fusion method, but it suffers the difficulty in deciding a nice Kalman filter gain. In this paper, a reinforcement learning-based extended Kalman filter compensation method is proposed, which learns the filter gain from historic data including sensor measurements and estimations. Simulation shows that the reinforcement learning method can effectively compensate for the filter gain and accurately estimate the position which verifies the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Long Staple Cotton Detection Method Based on improved Swin Transformer model
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Accurate identification of mature cotton in natural cotton fields is the key link to realize intelligent picking. Aiming at the problem of low recognition rate of CNN model when dealing with irregular and dense cotton, this paper improves Swin Transformer based on Transformer's long-distance modeling and parallel computing advantages, and combines CNN's local perception advantages, and proposes Swin Cotton model. The model can enhance the local perception capacity of the network through the local perception block, and effectively improve the recognition capacity of small noise in complex cotton field environment. The multi-scale aggregation block is used to merge low-level features into deep semantic features by attention mechanism. The improved model is compared with Faster-RCNN, YOLO and DETR models. Experiments show that after 200 epochs training, the mAP of Swin Cotton is 95% when IoU = 0.5, its precision was 93.3%, the recall rate was 92.4%, and the Fl value was 85.3%. Compared with other models, Swin Cotton also has higher recognition accuracy under overexposure, darkness, occlusion and adhesion. In the test collection of mature cotton pictures, Swin Transformer's test accuracy rate is 91.2%. In order to validate the robustness and generalization capacity of the model, test of the model is carried out with the data of different mature stages of cotton. The accuracy of cotton test in boll cracking stage is 83.1%, which shows that Swin Cotton has higher robustness and generalization in practical application.

articleTitle: PM-UNet: Lightweight network for lung image segmentation
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the field of image segmentation, it has been a research topic to pursue the lightweight of the model as much as possible without affecting the segmentation accuracy. The traditional U-Net is the classical segmentation model, but the number of parameters and computation required by the model are too large. To address this drawback, a lightweight network PM-UNet is proposed for lung image segmentation. Firstly, the ordinary 3×3 convolution used in the conventional U-Net is replaced by the new Inverted Residual Depthwise Separable convolution block to lighten the U-Net model. Also, to further compress the model, the four upsampling and downsampling networks of the lightweight U-Net are cut in half to simplify the network model. And atrous spatial pyramid pooling is used to expand the convolutional receptive field and add feature information of different scales. The attention gate can strengthen the information fusion effect of high-level and low-level information in the skip connection. The segmentation experiments were validated by using the LUNA competition lung image dataset, with the improved network model requiring only 2.2% and 14.4% of the number of parameters and computation of the traditional U-Net network, respectively. The experimental results of the network model achieved Accuracy of 0.991 and IOU of 0.958 on the test set, which is 0.6% improvement in Accuracy and 2.6% improvement in evaluation metric IOU compared to the conventional U-Net, and were tested against mainstream and recent segmentation networks. These results demonstrate that PM-UNet, which is improved on the basis of U-Net, has better segmentation effect on medical images.

articleTitle: Predesigned-trajectory induced attacks against multiagent systems on actuators
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Predesigned-trajectory induced attack problems against multiagent systems on actuators are investigated. The purpose of the induced attack is not to disrupt multiagent systems, but to inveigle it into a new trajectory. First, by constructing an attack generation exosystem, the induced attack signal is modeled, which is injected into the control command data of the actuator. Then, an functional expression of the predesigned trajectory is resolved, which describes the overall movement trajectory of multiagent systems under induced attacks. Furthermore, sufficient conditions of predesigned-trajectory induced attacks are derived by utilizing linear matrix inequalities. Finally, the theoretical results are verified to be effective through a simulation.

articleTitle: Ultra-Short-Term Photovoltaic Power Forecasting Based on Transformer Model
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the rapid depletion of traditional fossil energy and the increasing global environmental crisis, sustainable development has become the theme of today’s era. In order to ensure energy supply and control the degree of pollution, governments of various countries are making every effort to develop renewable energy. Among the new energy sources that are clean and renewable, the largest amount is solar energy. But its randomness and intermittent nature greatly limit the process of large-scale development and utilization. This requires accurate and effective prediction of photovoltaic power generation to reduce power system security issues caused by large-scale grid-connected photovoltaic power plants. In this paper, a novel transformer-based deep learning model is established for ultra-short-term photovoltaic power generation forecasting. In this study, the data set has a 15min interval for sampling, and the Transformer model is evaluated against the convolutional neural network(CNN) model and the long short-term memory(LSTM) model based on MSE, MAE, RMSE and R<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The experiment was analyzed from three perspectives: overall, sunny and cloudy. In the overall evaluation, the CNN model achieves an accuracy of 97.8%, the LSTM model achieves an accuracy of 97.9%, and the Transformer model achieves an accuracy of 98.1%. In the sunny evaluation, the CNN model reaches an accuracy of 98.5%, the LSTM model reaches an accuracy of 98.6%, and the Transformer model reaches an accuracy of 98.9%. In the cloudy evaluation, the CNN model attains an accuracy of 91.5%, the LSTM model attains an accuracy of 91.7%, and the Transformer model attains an accuracy of 92.1%. The prediction results indicate that the Transformer model surpasses other models.

articleTitle: Research on Maneuvering Decision of UCAV with Deep Q-network
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the context of intelligent air combat, the use of UCAVs to complete military operations is a current research hotspot. The autonomous maneuvering decision capability of UCAVs determines the winning and losing outcome of aerial combat. In order to study the problem of maneuvering decision-making in 1V1 air combat of UCAVs, this paper presents a maneuvering strategy generation algorithm for UCAVs based on deep Q-network. The environment in autonomous air combat is complex and variable. This paper firstly establishes a three-dimensional air combat situation and UCAV maneuvering model to satisfy the simulation research. According to the air combat situation assessment scheme, the variable weight theory is introduced to design the dynamic adjustable reward reshaping function, and a network model is trained by deep Q-network to make maneuvering decisions, so as to complete the autonomous combat. The results of simulation experiments show that the UCAVs is able to perform the perception of the current airspace situation under the given initial conditions. The maneuvering actions given by the maneuvering decision algorithm can increase the dominance value of UCAVs and maintain the dominant state, improving the maneuvering decision capability.

articleTitle: Leader-Following Attitude Synchronization of Multiple Flexible Spacecraft Systems Subject to External Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the leader-following attitude synchronization problem of multiple flexible spacecraft systems under external disturbances. Compared with existing works, the external disturbance with unbounded energy is compensated. First, we design a class of dynamic compensators by the internal model principle to tackle the external disturbance. Then, by introducing a series of coordinate transformations, we convert the leader-following attitude synchronization problem into a stabilization problem of an augmented system composed of the original multi-agent system and the dynamic compensator. Given that the leader system's state can be conveyed to each follower, we develop a distributed observer for the leader system. Finally, we develop a distributed control law to solve the problem. The effectiveness and robustness of the control law are illustrated by some numerical simulations.

articleTitle: MVSOP: A new framework for integrating MVS into SLAM based on ORB and PF
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Currently, the sparse map generated by simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM) based on features is insufficient for practical use. To acquire a dense map, the model of dense reconstruction is usually appended to the SLAM system. One of the issues is that the dense reconstruction is fully independent of the SLAM system. In other words, the dense reconstruction hardly utilizes any information from the SLAM. To sufficiently integrate the dense reconstruction with traditional visual SLAM frameworks, in this paper, a new framework for integrating dense reconstruction into SLAM based on ORB and PF is proposed. It combines the ORB features that have been utilized in the visual odometry of SLAM with multi-view stereo (MVS) for dense map reconstruction. To incorporate ORB features, a new particle filter model is designed. The model includes an observation model based on ORB features to rectify the estimation errors by the MVS method. In addition, A new asynchronous fusion algorithm is proposed to update the proposed model. Finally, the proposed framework is evaluated on a public dataset that includes several subsets, which demonstrates its rationality and effiency.

articleTitle: A study on the range of parameters for the classification of pulse diagrams of chord, slip and sink
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Based on the single-part pulse diagram, the reference range and discrimination criteria of the characteristic parameters and medical indicators of the chordal, slippery and sunken veins were established to improve the classification accuracy of the chordal, slippery and sunken veins. The pulses of 122 hospital disease populations were analyzed, including 23 cases of chordal pulse, 31 cases of slippery pulse and 58 cases of sunken pulse. Index parameters such as h3/h1, h4/h1, and w/t were extracted to explore the characteristic parameters and distribution ranges of the chordal, slippery, and sunken veins. The results showed that the three parameters h3/h1, h4/h1, and -w/t extracted from the seven reference points of the pulse could be statistically significant (P<0.01) as classification parameters for the chordal, slippery, and sunken veins, and the range of h3/h1 -was generally between 0.89 and 0.93, with no significant distinction between them. The upper and lower limits of h3/h1 for the slippery and sunken veins -were the same, and the differences in the ratios were not statistically significant, w/t of the chordal veins could be statistically significant (P<0.01) as an indicator for differentiating the chordal veins from the slippery and sunken veins. The reference range of medical indicators for the chordal, slippery, and sunken veins was established by measuring the characteristic parameters of the pulse map. Based on the index parameters with h3/h1, h4/h1, w/t and pulse shape as the core, the criteria for discriminating the chordal, slippery and sunken pulse maps can be established.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised fault diagnosis method based on dynamic data extension
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The accuracy of traditional deep learning models may be affected by labeled sample size. It is significant to design a semi-supervised learning method to make full use of massive unlabeled samples when there is limited data and the data quality is poor due to noise. However, traditional semi-supervised learning method is unable to guarantee the effectiveness of model since it only focuses on increasing labeled sample size but sample dimension, which also has an important impact to performance of model. This paper proposes a semi-supervised learning method based on dynamic extension not only can increase sample size but also increase sample dimension to improve the effectiveness of model. Dynamic extension is used to increase labeled sample dimension, and high-dimensional samples can use large models with stronger feature extraction capabilities to serve semi-supervised learning, which can effectively extract weak fault features submerged by noise. Experimental validation for benchmark dataset of rolling bearing shows that 30.3% improvement of fault diagnosis accuracy can be achieved in the case when only few labeled data with poor quality is available.

articleTitle: A Feedback-inspired Super-network Shrinking Framework for Flexible Neural Architecture Search
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Neural architecture search (NAS) has been proved to be effective in automatically designing the architectures of deep neural networks (DNNs). Currently, most of cell-based NAS methods are subjected to the prior rules of human experts on neural architectures (e.g., the topology-sharing strategy), but it is not in line with the sustainable development of automated machine learning (Auto-ML). In this paper, a feedback-inspired super-network shrinking (FSS) method is developed under the framework of differentiable architecture search (DARTS) such that neural networks with flexible architectures are derived without strong reliance on human experts. In FSS, the information entropy is utilized to measure the sparsity of the super-network and an adaptive shrinking method is developed to balance the cross-entropy and the sparsity entropy. The experiments on CIFAR10/100 demonstrate that the proposed ESF derives a set of neural architectures with competitive performance-computation trade-offs in one single search procedure, which is superior to the state-of-the-art NAS methods.

articleTitle: Cross-lingual Related Events Recognition Methods Based on The Event Central News Sets
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To help the public fully understand the ins and outs of an international or regional major event, we propose two cross-lingual related events recognition methods to acquire more related events in the news on different countries’ internet. Firstly news in different languages that focus on a same event are clustered into a news set. Then two method will be used together to determine whether two events are related. One is explicit related event recognition method which determines that by checking whether there is a description of one event can be found from another event central news set. The other one is implicit related event recognition method which determines that by a SVM classifier with several correlation and similarity features of two events. The experimental results show that the two methods are complementary to each other, and it is practical to use them together.

articleTitle: Sparse inference Type II fuzzy models optimized by Q-leaming algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper presents a sparse inference method for improving the structure of Type II fuzzy systems, which can extract fuzzy rules from data structures without any assumptions and has advantages in solving modelling problems for such non-linear systems as industrial production. Typically, the fuzzy rule base extracted from the data is often incomplete, resulting in reduced stability of data-driven fuzzy systems. At the same time, we also propose a method to automatically adjust the fuzzy set based on Q-learning algorithm and a self-learning strategy to adjust the parameters of fuzzy rules, which can effectively avoid forgetting the old knowledge. Finally, we use the proposed method for fitting functions and predicting the residual resistance of sailing boats as well as compare the results with those obtained by other methods in the literature. The experimental results show that the data forecast using the Type II fuzzy system model are in satisfactory agreement with the actual data.

articleTitle: Primary Design, Fabrication and Flight Test of Fixed-wing Electric UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The design and manufacturing process of a fixed-wing electric Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) is shown in detail based on certain aircraft capability requirements. After the parameters of the UAV are designed, the UAV is modeled and the flight data in three flight states is predicted using Simulink. Finally, the differences and reasons for flight tests versus predictions, and UAV improvements are discussed.

articleTitle: Detection of small defects on gear surface based on improved YOLOv7
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In industrial quality inspection, false inspection or undetected inspection often occur in the identification of gear surface minute defects. This paper presents a novel detection framework for identifying surface defects on gears, utilizing an enhanced version of YOLOv7. Firstly, we add a small target detection layer upon the foundation of YOLOv7 to enhance the network’s capability of accurately detecting smaller targets. Secondly, we replace the MP2 module with the MPCA module that integrates the CA (Coordinate Attention) mechanism, which can reduce the amount of computation and increase the network’s attention to small targets by suppressing the interference of unnecessary information. Finally, for small and dense defects on the gear surface, the original Binary Cross Entropy Loss and CIoU Loss are substituted with the Varifocal Loss and SIoU Loss to train the network. The empirical findings demonstrate that the improved model significantly enhances the precision and recall rate of small defects detection. mAP@0.5 achieves 77.7%, exhibiting a notable improvement of 3.3% over the baseline YOLOv7 model, and better than other one-stage target detection networks.

articleTitle: Rapid Recognition and Semantic Segmentation of Molten Steel Distribution Images on a Steel Ladle Surface based on the Improved SqueezeNAS Network
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Techniques of real-time image recognition of slag-steel distribution on the surface of a steel ladle under bottom argon-blowing (BAB) conditions are vital for monitoring and adjustment of BAB parameters and improving refining efficiency at industrial sites. An improved SqueezeNAS, a rapid semantic segmentation network, was proposed for the segmentation of molten steel distribution images on the surface of a steel ladle under BAB. The improved SqueezeNAS changed the inverted residual basic unit for search, reduced the search space, and introduced a hybrid dilated convolution (HDC) into the search space to avoid the grid effect of dilated convolution. By taking pictures of the molten steel distribution on the slag-steel surface under steel ladle BAB at a steel mill in real-time, a distribution image segmentation dataset of molten steel on the surface of a steel ladle in industrial scenarios was established, and the images were preprocessed to obtain target images. Additionally, the target images were segmented using the improved SqueezeNAS, being further recognized and classified by deep learning. The mean intersection over union (mIoU) of the dataset images of the steel ladle under BAB was 98.17%, indicating superior segmentation performance compared with U-Net, SegNet, SqueezeNAS network models. The average blowing time shortened 2 min or more and the increment of nitrogen was less after the improved SqueezeNAS segmenting used in the BAB monitor system for the same grade steels.

articleTitle: A Conflict Detection and Avoidance Strategy for Train Operations Based on Petri Nets
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The modeling of train group behaviors is the basis of train operation control on the railway networks. Train operations can be regarded as a typical discrete-event dynamic system. Time colored Petri nets (TCPNs) are a good mathematical tool for describing this type of discrete models and has been widely used in the field of railway transportation. In this paper, a TCPN model is established to describe the train operations of railway networks. The train operations time information is carried by token time assignment. This provides the model basis for analyzing conflict problems during train operations. A conflict detection and avoidance control strategy is developed to check the feasibility of train operation schedule in real time. When a train operation schedule is delayed or generates conflicts by unforeseen events, the strategy can generate a new conflict-free train operation schedule to ensure safe operations of trains. Finally, the correctness and effectiveness of the control strategy are verified by example analyses.

articleTitle: Self-Attention-Enhanced Fine-Grained Information Fusion for Multi-View Clustering
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Traditional multi-view methods often employ neural networks to extract features for clustering tasks. However, the obtained features are typically coarse-grained descriptions of multi-view data, and their discriminating power is limited. Fine-grained information is capable of providing more comprehensive data descriptions and detailed information. As a result, exploiting fine-grained features of multi-view data is of great significance for multi-view clustering. In this paper, we propose a self-attention-enhanced fine-grained information fusion method for multi-view clustering. Specifically, a linear layer is used to map raw multi-view data from different dimensions to a common dimension. Then, a fine-grained information extraction layer consisting of two convolution layers is employed to extract fine-grained information, which allows detailed information to be represented sufficiently. The self-attention learning module is utilized to determine which information the model should focus on and to fuse important information into a new feature representation. We adopt deep divergence-based clustering to maintain the compactness within a cluster and separation between clusters. Contrastive learning is leveraged to learn consistent clustering results between different views. We conduct experiments on multiple datasets, and the results demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed self-attention-enhanced fine-grained information fusion method for multi-view clustering.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Attitude Controller for A Quadrotor Transporting the Payload With Unknown Mass
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: An adaptive control approach is presented in this article to deal with the impacts of carrying a payload with unknown mass by a quadrotor. This approach can effectively control the quadrotor’s attitude stability. The paper commences by presenting the dynamic model of the quadrotor, followed by the development of a controller to manage its attitude control. Through Lyapunov analysis, the stability of the controller is validated. Ultimately, the proposed controller and a backstepping controller are used to controlling the attitude of the quadrotor, respectively, and experimental outcomes substantiate the efficiency and feasibility of the introduced controller.

articleTitle: Critical Stabilization and Essential Destabilization of Discrete Time Multi-delay Stochastic Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to investigate the concepts of critical stabilization and essential destabilization in discrete time multi-delay stochastic systems. To accomplish this objective, we utilize the feasible model augmented method and construct a multi-delay dependent Lyapunov operator that is both innovative and effective. Building on the defined Lyapunov operator, we present necessary and sufficient conditions for the critical stabilization and essential destabilization. Additionally, we provide a numerical example to demonstrate the practical applicability of our theoretical findings.

articleTitle: Strength analysis and vibration characteristics of a propulsion motor in the Pine Wind subway system
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A subway’s air supply system is key to ensuring passengers’ safety and comfort. The strength of the main propulsion motor is an important mechanical property. If the motor’s strength is insufficient, it affects airflow stability. In addition, because of its inherent frequency, operational reliability is directly affected by the vibration of the main propulsion motor. Therefore, it is necessary to study the strength and vibration characteristics of the main propulsion motor. The analysis performed here is focused on the strength characteristics of the casing and vibration characteristics of the stator, casing, rotor, shaft, and the entire assembly. By analyzing the electric machine’s vibration frequencies and mass participation coefficients, the casing of the main propulsion motor is optimized to avoid resonance and ensure safe operation.

articleTitle: Adaptive Neural Control for an Uncertain 2-DOF Robotic System With Coupled Input Constraint
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, an adaptive neural control method with coupled input constraint for a two degrees of freedom(DOF) uncertain robotic system is studied. A transformation matrix is proposed to handle the coupled input constraint problem. The coupled input constrained problem is transformed into an uncoupled input constraint problem. The incorporation of neural network techniques is aimed at addressing the uncertainty of the 2-DOF robot system. An analysis based on Lyapunov stability theory is given to illustrate the stability of the robot system with coupled input constraint. In addition, simulations are conducted on a 2-DOF robot system to further prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control.

articleTitle: Design of consensus controller for multi-agent systems with noncontinuous information transmission and second-order nonlinear dynamics
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, consensus controller that doesn’t depend on continuous information transmission for 2nd-order nonlinear multi-agent systems (MASs) is given to deal with event-triggered control problem. So as to remove dependence of continuous information transmission, both dynamic event-triggered mechanism and state observer are employed to design consensus controller.
