Each agent constructs state observers for its neighbor agents, and uses observers’ states to design controller for consensus object and dynamic event-trigger mechanism for event instant decision. We also proved that MASs can reach consensus with noncontinuous information transmission, and no Zeno-behavior occurs. In the end, the given consensus protocol is applied to an example to show the effectiveness.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Large Temperature Difference and Energy Saving of Central Air Conditioning System of Luxury Cruise Ship
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The steam compression chiller of traditional central air conditioning generally adopts the operation strategy of variable frequency and constant temperature difference of chilled water and cooling water, which has the problems of low unit operation efficiency and high power consumption of matching variable frequency water pump. To solve these problems, a strategy to change the temperature difference and flow of chilled water is proposed. By establishing the mathematical model of chiller, variable frequency water pump and seawater heat exchange module, TRNSYS is used for experimental simulation. The experimental results show that this strategy can effectively reduce the operating energy consumption of the central air conditioning system, reduce the selection requirements of variable frequency water pumps for chillers, and save some equipment costs.

articleTitle: A new discrete filled function algorithm for inventory optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The discrete filled function is an effective way to solve large-scale optimization problems, which has been widely used in various applications. In this paper, a new kind of discrete filled function that does not depend on initial parameters is first designed. Then, an algorithm with the proposed discrete filled function is presented. It is applied to the inventory optimization problem, where a Monte Carlo process is used in the selection of initial conditions. Finally, one simulation example is given to show the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Layout Optimization of Square Parts Based on BL-IGA Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Square products are a kind of products formed by assembling several layout accessories after plane processing with the plate as the main original piece. In order to improve the utilization rate of plate, this paper proposes a square layout optimization model based on BL-IGA algorithm. First, the data set is processed and analyzed; Secondly, a mixed integer programming model is established with the decision variables as the product project portfolio sequence and the objective function as the plate utilization maximization After that, the BL algorithm and the improved genetic algorithm (BL-IGA) are used to solve the above model, the chromosome is encoded into the item sequence, and the BL algorithm is used to arrange the item sequence (rotatable) on the original plank of the specified size under the constraint conditions, until all the items in the chromosome are arranged, and the utilization rate of the generated sheet is used as the individual fitness. In order to solve this problem better, IGA adopts non-repeating integer coding, sequential crossover and reverse mutation. At the same time, the improved crossover probability and mutation probability genetic algorithm makes it have better global search ability and faster convergence speed. Finally, the utilization rate of plate can reach about 70 % by using the square layout optimization model based on BL-IGA algorithm. In addition, with the increase of data size, the change rate of running time of the BL-IGA algorithm generally shows a downward trend, showing a better time complexity.

articleTitle: Abnormal condition monitoring method of cement pre-decomposition process based on PCA and AutoEncoder network
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The accurate monitoring of abnormal production conditions in cement process is the basis of intelligent control, which is of great significance to improve the intelligent level of cement production. In this paper, an abnormal condition monitoring method of cement pre-decomposition process based on PCA and AutoEncoder network is proposed. In order to improve the accuracy of anomaly detection, this paper integrates the PCA and AutoEncoder algorithms. Firstly, the anomaly detection models based on PCA and AutoEncoder are constructed. On this basis, anomaly monitoring thresholds based on PCA and AutoEncoder are determined. For the samples to be tested, the PCA-based and AutoEncoder-based reconstruction errors are obtained and compared with the reconstruction error thresholds. If any of the judgments are abnormal, the test sample is in an abnormal state. Finally, taking the kiln tail crusting condition in the cement pre-decomposition link as an example, the feasibility of the proposed method is verified. The identification results shows that for the 440 test samples, only 4 abnormal points are not identified for the abnormal working conditions of kiln tail crusting. This paper provided a feasible method for abnormal condition monitoring of cement pre-decomposition process.

articleTitle: Research on neural network method for online temperature measurement of FSW
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The friction stir welding process is used for the fuel tank of heavy launch vehicles. Due to the increase in the size of the fuel tank and the large temperature difference between the long and thick welding seams, it is difficult to achieve the stability of the welding process, resulting in a significant decrease in the strength and performance of the welds. This paper studies the temperature signals in the core region of friction stir welding process, establishes a real-time temperature detection system for friction stir welding, and further studies and constructs a BP neural network model to predict welding temperature, laying a foundation for temperature control and improving welding stability in friction stir welding. The results show that the established real-time temperature detection system for friction stir welding can meet the requirements of engineering applications while effectively detecting the welding temperature; The BP neural network model established based on the temperature measurement system can predict the welding temperature using the spindle rotation speed, feed speed, and pressing amount.

articleTitle: Optimal tracking control for a nonlinear system with constrained-input via model-free reinforcement learning
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper uses a model-free adaptive control algorithm to look into the optimal tracking control policy for multi-agent unknown nonlinear systems with constrained input. By building a new augmented multi-agent nonlinear system to represent the original system, we can obtain the optimal control policy by seeking the solution of the coupled Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman (HJB) equation of the new system. Firstly, we adopted the traditional model-based technique to prove the feasibility of the technique of solving the HJB equation. Then, for the sake of avoid the difficult problem of solving HJB equation, we adopted the model-free method and used an actor-critic architecture to get the approximate solution of HJB equation. Meanwhile, we also affirm the stability of the system with the optimal control policy by employing the Lyapunov approach. The effectiveness of the algorithm is verified through a simulation example.

articleTitle: Proximal Policy Optimization-based Reinforcement Learning for End-to-end Autonomous Driving
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper proposes an end-to-end method based on deep reinforcement learning (DRL) for autonomous driving (AD) in diverse road conditions. The proposed method is developed based on the proximal policy optimization (PPO). The solution is composed of an encoder network for image processing and a policy network for autonomous driving. By converting the image into a multi-dimensional vector through the encoder network, the time for autonomous driving vehicles (ADVs) to process the environmental information is reduced. Moreover, The attention mechanism-based squeeze-and-excitation networks (SENet) block is added to the encoder network to improve the accuracy of extracting the road information from raw images, thus greatly accelerating the convergence. Next, a specific reward function is designed for the simulation. The reward function is about the deviation from the center lane and the yaw angle for autonomous driving vehicles. The actor-critic structure optimizes network parameters to perform policy improvements and obtain the optimal policy based on accumulated experience. The proposed method has been verified in the CARLA simulation environment. The results demonstrate that the driving stability of autonomous driving vehicles get improvements.

articleTitle: Technology of Fuzzy Active Disturbance Rejection Control for Quadrotor UAV
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of nonlinearity, strong coupling, and underactuation in the flight control system of the quadrotor UAV, a fuzzy active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) strategy is designed. In this control strategy, fuzzy control is introduced based on ADRC technology, and the attitude angle channels and altitude channel of a quadrotor UAV are simulated and analyzed. Besides, the results are compared with those of classical ADRC and PID control. The simulation results show that under some external disturbances, the designed controller can well estimate and compensate for the total disturbance, and the stability and robustness of the fuzzy ADRC system response are stronger than those of classical ADRC and PID control.

articleTitle: Enhancing Outdoor Fruit Localization Accuracy: A Stereo Network Approach with Parallax Attention
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Accurate fruit localization is a crucial and challenging task for achieving automated fruit harvesting in orchards. The depth information output by the stereo camera suffers from the problems of insufficient filling rate and noise, which will affect the accuracy of fruit localization. In this paper, we propose a stereo matching network based on attention mechanism to improve the quality of depth information. The network first extracts multi-scale features from left and right views, then uses the attention mechanism to generate the disparity cost, and finally the refinement disparity map is output from the network. Based on the disparity, we obtain the depth information and estimate the centroid of the fruit using the 3D frustum method. We collected orchard data and trained the network model to verify the effectiveness of the stereo matching network on the orchard dataset. Finally, fruit localization experiments were conducted based on the network, and the results show that the accuracy of fruit localization has been improved.

articleTitle: RGBD-SLAM Algorithm Based on Semantic Segmentation and Background Restoration in Dynamic Scenes
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To address the problem that RGBD-SLAM algorithm is difficult to effectively identify dynamic objects affecting trajectory accuracy in dynamic scenarios, improved a novel RGBD-SLAM algorithm based on Semantic segmentation and Background repair in dynamic scenarios (ISB-SLAM). This algorithm accurately marks potential dynamic objects by designing a semantic analysis module with a fusion of class embedding, decoder and patch coding to analyze the global linkage of the marked target regions and also output the analyzed target regions in categories. To reduce the impact of dynamic objects on the localization accuracy of the SLAM system, dynamic objects are judged and eliminated by multi-view geometry. The static background of the rejection region is complemented according to the multi-frame grid mapping method, which provides good feature information for SLAM map building. The experimental results show that the algorithm improves the trajectory accuracy and has a good composition capability in the public datasets TUM and BONN.

articleTitle: Strategy of Estimating State of Charge of Lithium-Ion Based on Improved Extended Kalman Filter
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To achieve a sufficiently accurate estimation of the battery charge state and reduce the effects of various disrupting elements on the estimation results as much as feasible, This paper presents an SOC (State-of-Charge) estimation scheme that combines the Ampere Hour Integral Method and the Extended Kalman Filter (EKF). The scheme is based on an equivalent circuit model utilizing double RC networks, the DP model. Validated by simulation with HPPC working conditions, simulation results show that the joint algorithm outperforms the Ampere Hour Integral method and EKF methods alone, as well as dependability and practicality.

articleTitle: Research on damage measurement technology of range based on 3D modeling
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Based on the technical requirements of range damage evaluation, a method of measuring range physical damage based on UAV rapid three-dimensional modeling is proposed in this paper. In this paper, the overall technical route of the range physical damage measurement is designed, and the key technical issues such as the construction of efficient data acquisition system based on UAV platform, the construction of three-dimensional model based on the grid segmentation and matching algorithm and the automatic detection and measurement of the changing area based on the three-dimensional model are studied, and the technical route method of the study is verified in the experimental area and the target test scene respectively.

articleTitle: Time-Synchronized Control of Unmanned Dynamic Positioning Ships
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this work, a time-synchronized control (TSC) for the unmanned dynamic positioning ship is studied. Different from the traditional control, a new concept of time-synchronized stability (TSS) is defined based on ratio persistence, which can guarantee different freedom degrees of ship tracking errors converge to zero at the same moment. In addition, the classic sign function is revisited and a norm-normalized sign function is defined. Combined with the sliding mode control (SMC) and TSS, a TSS is designed for the unmanned dynamic positioning system (UDPS) of ships. Finally, simulation is constructed to demonstrate that tracking errors in the different freedom degrees of dynamic positioning ships converge to the equilibrium point at the same moment.

articleTitle: Research on the QR Code Mobile Payment System based on Passive IoT
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Mobile payment via QR (Quick Response) code is the main payment method in current days which faces with many potential payment risks. To tackle with the fraudulent transactions of QR code, the study presents a secure mobile payment system based on passive IoT, and a payment instrument featured by lifecycle energy supply is also designed. The experimental results show that the remote fraudulent transactions via QR code can be well detected. Besides, the properties of interaction time and success rate of the proposed mobile payment system perform well, especially in the low payment frequency. Besides, the payment instrument can gain sufficient energy to meet the demand of energy consumption. This paper is aimed at providing helpful solutions for IoT payments in the area of specially-engaged commercial units and government-issued vouchers.

articleTitle: Non-convex Optimization Based On Deep Koopman Operator
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Non-convex optimization problems are prevalent in various fields, and finding the global optimal solution for such problems remains challenging. This paper proposes an optimization method based on deep Koopman operator, which leverages the power of deep neural networks to provide a data-driven architecture for the Koopman function. The Koopman operator is used to linearly represent non-convex problems, and the proposed method utilizes model predictive control to optimize the resulting linear systems. Simulation results show that this method can solve the non-convex optimization problem effectively, quickly and accurately, while obtaining the global optimal solution.

articleTitle: Trajectory Planning of Robot Terminal Pose by Interpolation Method
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to improve the stability of the robot at work, this paper adds an insertion point between the end of the robot and the next target point, and changes the original linear trajectory to a new trajectory planned by interpolation method. The simulation experiment is carried out in MATLAB software. The interpolation method curve is compared with the linear curve. The optimization results show that the velocity and acceleration curves under the interpolation method become more gentle, which verifies the effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Virtual Commands in Control Allocation for Reconfigurable Flight Control Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: For safety and reliability, fault-tolerant control of an aircraft is demanding. Control allocation, which is to allocate the upper-level control commands to redundant actuators according to optimization objectives and constraints, is one of the key problems in fault-tolerant control. In this paper, the aircraft moment equation for reconfigurable flight control establishes the virtual control commands for control allocation. To test the virtual control commands, straight and level flight under the condition of actuator failure is simulated using MATLAB/Simulink. The results show that the appropriate virtual control inputs and control allocation outputs can compensate for actuator faults without redesigning the controller to improve flight reliability and safety.

articleTitle: A Full-trajectory Design Method for a Waverider Hypersonic Vehicle with Boost-glide-attack Process
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A guidance controller is designed for the boost-glide waverider hypersonic vehicle, which can meet the requirements of the whole flight. The task of reaching the desired altitude and velocity at the end of the boost phase will be achieved through the controller. So that the vehicle can perform long distance maneuvers in the condition of quasi-balanced glide, and finally dive to hit the target. The performance of the controller is verified by simulation. The guidance controller can make the hypersonic vehicle to complete the flight task and meet the control requirements of hypersonic vehicle maneuver.

articleTitle: An Immune Genetic Algorithm Based Combinatorial Auction Model in Smart Grid
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The application of distributed energy and renewable energy in the smart grid has broadened power sources and increased the diversity of power supply and demand. To meet the needs for combined electric energy, and to achieve the balance of power supply and demand, this paper chooses the transaction mechanism of the combinatorial auction to realize optimal energy scheduling. In the combinatorial auction, bidders can bid for any combination of all energies, which meets the diversified power needs of users. A combinatorial auction model to maximize the overall auction proceeds is constructed considering the needs of both the user and generation side. For the electricity trading optimal scheduling problem, this paper employs a genetic algorithm to solve the combinatorial auction model, and the immune operator is added to the algorithm to address the problem of degeneration and better extract features of the auction problem. Moreover, a large number of simulations are performed to verify the feasibility, effectiveness, and practicability of the immune genetic algorithm. The adaptive value of the population is improved and population degeneration is prevented.

articleTitle: Decentralized Adaptive Impedance Control of Reconfigurable Robot Manipulators for Human Robot Collaboration
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: For the problem of dynamic contact force tracking control under human robot collaboration (HRC), we propose a dual closed-loop decentralized adaptive control framework. The dynamic model of reconfigurable robot manipulator (RRM) subsystem is established based on joint torque feedback (JTF) technology. On the basis of fully analyzing the model uncertainty, the method based on decomposition is used to dynamically compensate the model uncertainty. Using Lyapunov theory, the uniform and ultimate boundedness (UUB) of dynamic contact force tracking error and RRM position tracking error in HRC process are confirmed. A neural network (NN) observer is designed to dynamically compensate the uncertainty of controller. Finally, the effectiveness of this method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Adaptive Tracking Control for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems With Unknown Exosystem and Disturbances
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the tracking control problem for heterogeneous multi-agent systems with an unknown exosystem and the external bounded disturbances. A distributed model-free adaptive observer is proposed to estimate state and dynamics of the unknown exosystem. The control input of each follower is contaminated by the unknown time-varying disturbance which damage the tracking performance. Then an adaptive anti-disturbance compensator is proposed to neutralize the negative influence of the external disturbance. In the light of the proposed distributed model-free adaptive observer and adaptive anti-disturbance compensator, an adaptive anti-disturbance tracking control protocol is designed to guarantee that the output of each follower can track the exosystem. A simulation example is provided to demonstrate the availability of the presented control scheme.

articleTitle: Shrinkage estimator based-DGLRSQ for motor imagery classification
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Motor imagery classification is a crucial task in the field of brain-computer interfaces (BCI)which can benefit individuals with disabilities in their movements of their limbs. However, accurately classifying such signals poses a significant challenge owing to the complexity of the signal dynamics. This paper proposes a approach for motor imagery classification utilizing shrinkage estimator-based dynamic generalized learning Riemannian space quantization (DGLRSQ). Our proposed approach aims to provide a more accurate estimated covariance matrix by utilizing a shrinkage estimator, which avoids overfitting through data regularization. Additionally, the impact of the sliding window size on the classification performance is investigated, where shorter shifting size delivers better classification performance but with lower computational efficiency. Experimental results demonstrate the efficacy of our method and its superior performance on the publicly available BCIIV 2a motor imagery EEG dataset.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning-based Position Control for a Disc-shaped Underwater Remotely Operated Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper presents the design and development of a deep reinforcement learning-based controller for a disc-shaped underwater remotely operated vehicle (Disc-ROV). The control process is modeled as a Markov decision process (MDP) with unknown state transition probabilities. One critical issue with conventional RL-based control methods is steady-state error. To reduce the final control error, we introduce an integral method to the actor-critic structure. Another issue is the lack of smoothness in the actions, which can be harmful to the actuators. To address this issue, we introduce an additional penalty to the training loss of policy learning, which eliminates high-frequency components in the control signal. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in a simulation environment with a position control task. The simulation results demonstrate the accuracy and stability of the trained position control strategy.

articleTitle: Velocity Feedback Control with Anti-Interference for SCARA Parallel Five-bar Manipulator
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Robotic manipulator, as an important robot system, have been widely used in various production and manufacturing tasks, such as automated manufacturing, logistics, and assembly. The parallel manipulator has a more stable structure, better rigidity, high repetitive positioning accuracy, no cumulative error, and faster speed compared to the serial manipulator. In this paper, this article mainly derives the formulas for inverse kinematics and velocity Jacobian, designs a closed-loop velocity controller, and verified by Matlab Simulink software. Later, the feasibility of the simulation is confirmed by building an experimental platform, further confirming the effectiveness of the theory. This article provides a reference and guidance for theoretical research and practical application in the field of manipulator control, aiming to achieve more efficient and stable manipulator control.

articleTitle: Research on False Data Injection Attack in Smart Grid Based on Improved Conformer
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming the difficulty that detecting false data injection attack (FDIA) concentrates on attack existence detection and fails to get the accurate attacked location, a method for smart grid FDIA detection based on improved Conformer is proposed. Firstly, by using the meta-ACON as a new active activation function to take the place of the Relu activation function in the original module, called Convolutional Subsamping module, a network model with higher accuracy and better generalization ability can be obtained. Then, adding the convolution module to the original Conformer module, and changing the order of the modules, the feature extraction capability of the model can be enhanced. Meanwhile, the Smoothing Maximum Unit (SMU) activation function is chosen to replace the Swish activation function in the Conformer algorithm to optimize the training model and improve the recognition accuracy. Finally, the simulation is conducted on the IEEE-14 node test system for verification. The results indicate that the enhanced Conformer algorithm achieves a detection accuracy of 99.42%, which confirms the effectiveness of the proposed method for precise localization detection.

articleTitle: Synchronization of stochastic coupled systems on networks with time-varying coupling structure
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the synchronization of stochastic coupled systems on networks with time-varying coupling structure (SCSNTC). Firstly, a stochastic coupled system we consider can be described by a network which coupling structure is time-varying. Then, by combining Lyapunov method with basic graph theory and using feedback control, a Lyapunov-type theorem as well as a coefficients-type criterion are respectively given to make sure drive and response systems to reach p- th moment exponential synchronization. As an application, the synchronization of stochastic Kuramoto oscillators with time-varying coupling structure is analyzed based on the obtained theoretical results in mechanical systems. Eventually, a numerical example is established to demonstrate the validity of our results.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of xR Extended Reality Shooting Technology in the Experimental Drama "Pipa Xing"
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The virtual 3-Dimensional (Hereinafter referred to as 3D) scene presented by the Light Emitting Diode (Hereinafter referred to as LED) screen in the Extended Reality (Hereinafter referred to as xR) virtual studio field changes in real time with the changes of the performance and shooting of real actors, so that the creativity of directors, photographers, actors, stage artists and other creative personnel can be better played and expressed in the scene. In the limited environment, the virtual space extends freely with the creativity of the creator, and the narrative is presented artistically in the virtual image. It is shown as an image creation mode with the integration of immersive virtual scene and real performance. Compared with the traditional creation mode, xR technology has a broad space for innovation in production technology and creative methods, and the research on aesthetic experience has a great value of continuous exploration and experiment. Taking the experimental drama "Pipa Xing" recorded and filmed by the China Institute of Arts Science & Technology in 2022 as an example, The drama is an important scientific research achievement of the project "extended reality Technology (xR) Applied Research in Two Innovations of Traditional Culture" established by China Institute of Arts Science & Technology. The article discusses the important topics such as the immersive experience of xR technology in creating immersive experience and the "infinite expansion" of performance space for performing arts.

articleTitle: Design of Interdigital Capacitance electrode for Multi-interface Measurement of Crude Oil Tank
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, interdigital capacitance electrodes for multiphase interface measurement in crude oil storage tanks are presented. The electrodes are fabricated using a flexible printed circuit (FPC) board. They can be housed within an insulated tube, enhancing sensor sealing and making it particularly suitable for industrial applications. The electrodes model is created using COMSOL software, and simulations are conducted. Based on the simulation results, the probes demonstrates the potential for using in multiphase interface measurements.

articleTitle: A study of contrastive self-supervised learning generalization based on augmented data
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Contrastive learning have been widely applied recently, since only with unlabeled data, it produced results comparable to the state-of-the-art supervised algorithm. Data augmentation plays an essential role in defining effective predictive task, influencing generalization of the model. We find that high-intensity data augmentation is conducive to achieving a wider aggregation of intra-class samples, obtaining more effective features to improve generalization; however, extremely strong augmentation leads to the information loss of different classes, resulting in cross-class deviation of samples, reducing model generalization. We demonstrate our finding through experiment on CIFAR-10 dataset, analyzing the impact of different data augmentation operations on recognition results and the corresponding reasons. Our experimental verification on the relationship between the data augmentation and the generalization of contrastive self-supervised learning agree with our theoretical description.

articleTitle: An active disturbance rejection control for underactuated AUV
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of uncertain parameters and sensitive external interference of the underactuated autonomous underwater vehicle(AUV), an active disturbance rejection controller (ADRC) is proposed. On the basis of arranging the transition process for the desired attitude, an extended state observer is designed to compensate the total perturbations real-time, which can overcome the external disturbances such as strong coupling, model uncertainty and water flow variation. In addition, the nonlinear state error feedback is designed to effectively suppress the tracking error. The stability control, disturbance immunity and robustness of the ADRC system are tested on the simulation platform, and the quantitative analysis is carried out with cascade PID control system. The results from the simulation prove that the designed active disturbance rejection controller can estimate and compensate the internal and external interference of the system well. Also it has strong robustness to the uncertainty of the parameters of the AUV. The performance index is obviously better than cascade PID.

articleTitle: Lightweight Vision Transformer for Small Data Sets
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the rapid development of Transformers in the field of computer vision, models based on Transformers have become highly competitive architectures in the area. Although variants of Transformer models have achieved increasing accuracy on image classification tasks, the size of the training set and the number of parameters required by the models have increased dramatically. When dealing with small datasets, such models face problems such as overfitting and undergeneralization, leading to poor accuracy on the test set. We propose a new lightweight vision transformer (LVT) to address these issues. We reconstructed the backbone network, which learns the relationship between pixels through local window self-attention and global self-attention computation. We also use the attention pooling approach to fuse the token sequences generated by the backbone network more meticulously. We trained on the CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100 datasets from scratch and compared them with a modern convolutional neural network. The experimental results show that LVT outperforms the modern convolutional neural network in terms of accuracy and efficiency. On the test set of CIFAR-10, we have obtained an accuracy of 96.83%, which indicates that our model can effectively solve the problems facing the training of small datasets and has a wide range of application prospects.

articleTitle: Fast Image-free high precision target tracking using single pixel detection
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The fast location tracking of moving targets is of great significance for navigation and guidance. The image-based tracking methods usually require massive sampling and data storage. In order to realize the fast tracking of the target, we propose an image-free method based on single pixel detection. The proposed method uses Fourier slice theorem to directly obtain the one-dimensional projection information of the target. At extremely low sampling, the one-dimensional projection curve is simplified into a gently changing crest, but the peak of the curve at this time still contains the central coordinate information of the target. By post-processing the projection curve at different sampling rates and selecting appropriate tracking characteristics, the accuracy can be maintained while further reducing the sampling rate and simplifying the calculation. In addition, the background subtraction is utilized to remove the effect of background information, so that the target can still be tracked in a complex background. The effectiveness of the proposed method in different background conditions is verified by simulations. Under the spatial resolution of 256×256 pixels, the sampling rate of the proposed method can be reduced to 0.012%, which greatly shortens the sampling time. At the same time, the proposed method has small error with less than one pixel in the horizontal and vertical directions.

articleTitle: Distributed Lattice Smooth Variable Structure Filter for Target Tracking Under Model Uncertainty
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The conventional filters algorithm cannot provide a stable and precise state estimation for target tracking in Air Traffic Control (ATC) with motion model uncertainty. In this paper, the new filter and distributed fusion strategies are proposed. First, a Lattice Smooth Variable Structure Filter (LSVSF) is proposed for nonlinear system with model uncertainty, which avoids the calculation of Jacobi matrices. Then, the distributed lattice smooth variable structure filter Distributed Lattice Smooth Variable Structure Filter (MW-LSVSF) is proposed, and the cross-covariance of local estimators is calculated by lattice sampling. Finally, the state estimation accuracy and robustness are verified by ATC scenarios.

articleTitle: A Localization Optimization Algorithm with Improved Feature Tracking Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aiming at the traditional SLAM algorithm to extract the matching time consuming, which makes it difficult to run in real time, this paper proposes a fast SLAM algorithm with improved tracking method. The algorithm introduces the tracking decision of fusion of feature and optical flow, filters the input frames first, classifies different frames into feature frames and optical flow frames, extracts feature points only in feature frames, and tracks the points in feature frames in optical flow frames, which avoids time-consuming matching and improves the real-time performance of the algorithm; in the time-sharing asynchronous tracking session, feature tracking and bidirectional optical flow tracking are performed for the classified feature frames and optical flow frames respectively. The test results in the publicly available TUM dataset show that the algorithm of this paper has better advantages in real-time performance and adaptability to the environment.

articleTitle: Polar Integrated Navigation Algorithm Based on Transverse Earth Coordinate System
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of longitude convergence occurs in polar region, which leads to the lack of northbound reference and calculation overflow in the north-pointing inertial navigation system, we propose a polar region applicable integrated navigation algorithm. The algorithm constructs the transverse earth coordinate system, solves the problem of no north reference and calculation overflow in the polar region. By introducing GNSS-assisted navigation information, the polar SINS/GNSS filtering model is established, which solves the problem of periodic oscillation error in transverse inertial navigation and the accumulation of position error with time, and improves the accuracy of navigation parameters. Through simulation experiments, the results show that the algorithm can solve the problems of calculation overflow and oscillation error in polar navigation, improve the precision of polar navigation, and meet the requirements of polar navigation.

articleTitle: Boundary Control for a Nonlinear Two-link Rigid-flexible Manipulator in Three-dimensional Workspace with Full State Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper discusses the vibration control for a two-link rigid-flexible manipulator in 3D space with angular position and speed constraints. A nonlinear hybrid PDE-ODE model is derived and based on asymmetric barrier Lyapunov functions, a boundary feedback controller is proposed to realize joint states control, vibration suppression, and full state constraints. The asymptotic stability of the closed-loop system is verified by analyzing PDE solutions. Moreover, to improve robustness, a robust boundary controller using the sign function is presented to restrain input disturbances. Numerical simulations are conducted to illustrate the effectiveness and robust performance of the proposed controllers.

articleTitle: H∞ Control for Discrete-Time Interconnected Large-Scale Systems With Round-Robin Scheduling Protocol
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper explores the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control issue for discrete-time interconnected large-scale systems based on Round-Robin scheduling protocol. Round-Robin scheduling protocol is used to eliminate overload conditions in the sensor-to-controller network. For difficulties with more systems, the matrices of subsystems are widened to facilitate processing and the decentralized control mechanism is selected to enhance system stability. Minimal upper bound on the cost function is found by the expectation and perfect square method. In addition, the desired gain matrices of a certain structure with elements only on the diagonal are obtained by means of the Riccati equations and an optimization issue. Finally, the proposed scheme is verified by a numerical example of continuous stirred-tank reactor systems.

articleTitle: An adaptive observer-based SOC estimation method for lithium-ion batteries against sensor measurement uncertainties
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Accurate estimation of battery state of charge (SOC) is critical for efficient and safe battery applications. The measurement uncertainties of sensors, including measurement noises and sensor bias will affect the estimation accuracy inevitably. Therefore, quantifying the relationship between the sensor measurement uncertainties and the SOC estimation errors and seeking better SOC estimation methods has been a hot topic of research. In this paper, model errors and SOC estimation errors under measurement noise and sensor bias are derived. The resulting analyses can be used to assess the robustness of the SOC estimates. In addition, an adaptive observer-based SOC estimation method for lithium-ion batteries is proposed to cope with the measurement uncertainty. Simulation experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: The LMS filtering algorithm optimized using an improved fractional-order cuckoo search algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To address the issues of slow convergence speed and low convergence accuracy in the traditional LMS (Least Mean Square) filtering algorithm, this paper proposes an improved Fractional-order Discrete Sparrow Search Algorithm (FDSSA) to optimize the LMS filtering algorithm. The design transforms the LMS filtering algorithm into an optimization problem for LMS filter parameters. The Circle chaotic initialization strategy is employed to initialize the initial positions of the individual cuckoos in the FDSSA, enhancing the diversity of the initial population. The improved FDSSA algorithm’s optimization capability is utilized to optimize the LMS filter parameters, enabling the filter parameters to achieve global optimal solutions and improving the convergence performance of the LMS filtering algorithm. As a result, the filtering and denoising performance is enhanced.

articleTitle: CSANet: Cross-Semantic Attention Network for Open-Set Object Recognition
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: With the increase of real-world scenarios such as robotics, urban rescue and autonomous driving, deep learning models are increasingly exposed to open-set scenarios where established methods should separate the known and unknown categories in the real world. However, most existing open-set recognition methods treat all features equally and focus on learning features that facilitate the discrimination of categories during the training, which is detrimental to the performance of models in the open world. In response to this challenge, we propose a novel framework based on a Cross-Semantic Attention Network (i.e., CSANet) to guide the model to explore more comprehensive features. In detail, we apply cross-semantic attention to guide both the high-level semantic features and a set of learnable category prototypes, which encourages the model to better characterise known categories and facilitates its ability to discriminate unknown categories in the open world. In addition, we develop a combined loss that widens the inter-category distance and narrows the intra-category distance, thus reserving the unknown categories a larger position in the feature space. Experimental results on several popular open-set recognition datasets demonstrate the effectiveness and efficiency of our method.

articleTitle: Joint SLAM and Joint Search of Unmanned Car Cluster
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This article proposes a co-search algorithm based on laser-visual fusion. The mobile robot cluster is based on the Mecanum wheel, lidar, and deep camera, and uses microprocessors such as Jetson Nano and STM32. Through the unmanned car cluster combined with simultaneous localization and mapping (SLAM), a high-precision grid map is obtained in a short term. Based on the cluster algorithm, the map area is allocated to a single robot for traversing search. During the search process, the target information is identified based on the YOLO algorithm and returned to the target information.

articleTitle: Point Cloud Registration Algorithm Fusing PCA and NDT
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To solve the problem that the parameter setting of the NDT point cloud registration algorithm requires considerable experience and it easily falls into local extremum when the initial poses between the point cloud to be registered with the target point cloud differ greatly, the point cloud registration algorithm fusing PCA and NDT is proposed. Firstly, PCA method is used to calculate the principal axis directions of two groups of point clouds, and the initial rigid body transformation matrix is acquired. Then, the problem of principal axis inversion is corrected by using the minimum condition of Euclidean distance mean square error when the principal axis of two groups of point clouds are in the same direction. The correct initial transformation matrix after the principal axis correction is calculated, and the coarse registration of point clouds is completed. To reduce the number of processing point, the two groups of point clouds are sampled under the grid. The rigid body transformation matrix acquired by rough registration is used as the initial position and orientation of the NDT registration algorithm for the point cloud precise registration to obtain the final rigid body transformation matrix. The registration experiment was carried out using the Stanford public database point cloud. The result of this experiment shows that the rotation angle error of the point cloud registration algorithm fusing PCA and NDT reaches 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>rad, and the translation component error is better than 0.01 mm. The proposed point cloud registration algorithm can effectively solve the initial position and attitude greater difference between point clouds, and it also can solve the problem of falling into local extremum during NDT registration. The registration accuracy basically meets the point cloud registration requirements, which can achieve fast and stable registration result with two groups of point clouds under any position and attitude.

articleTitle: Composite Guidance Law Against Maneuvering Target Considering Impact Angle Constraints
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: To intercept maneuvering targets with minimum miss distance and desired impact angles in finite time, this paper proposes a composite guidance law that contains adaptive sliding mode disturbance observer (ASMDO), nonsingular terminal sliding mode (NTSM) technique, and adaptive supertwisting (ASTW) technique. The ASMDO is implemented to estimate the target maneuver and its output is utilized as a feedforward control component. It is worth noting that the proposed observer does not require prior information about target acceleration. Considering the superiority of the NTSM technique, a guidance law based on NTSM is designed to drive angle and angular error converged in finite time. Moreover, to avoid the inherent chattering problem of sliding mode control, the adaptive sliding mode control technique is also employed. In addition, the finite time stability of the closed-loop system is demonstrated via the Lyapunov method. Finlay, the numerical simulations are established to verify the effectiveness of the proposed composite guidance law.

articleTitle: Directional Expelling for Unmanned Aerial Vehicle Swarm Based on False Deviation Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The present paper introduces a method of the directional expelling based on the false deviation attack aiming leaderless unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) swarm. First, the influence of false deviation attack on the formation and movement trajectory of UAV swarm is analyzed, where the false deviation attack influences the formation movement and changes the movement trajectory of the swarm. Then, an explicit expression for the center function is determined, which determined the movement trajectory of the UAV swarm after directional expelling. Finally, a numerical simulation result is provided as confirmation of the correctness of the aforementioned analytical findings.

articleTitle: LLC resonant control strategy based on fuzzy PI hybrid control
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: A fuzzy PI hybrid control strategy is proposed to address issues such as voltage gain range reverse-bursting under variable frequency control and poor response and robustness of traditional PI control for a full-bridge LLC resonant converter. Based on an analysis of the voltage gain characteristic of the converter, a switching point is selected at the resonance frequency and a hybrid control approach is adopted using variable frequency and phase shift control, which is suitable for a wide input voltage range. On top of this hybrid control approach, a fuzzy PI control is employed to reduce the complexity of the model construction process and improve the system’s dynamic response and adaptive capability. Finally, simulation experiments are conducted using MATLAB/Simulink to demonstrate the effectiveness and superiority of the proposed control strategy.

Author Keywords: variable frequency and Phase shift control

articleTitle: A Taguchi customized multi-objective particle swarm optimization method for emergency repair of distribution network
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The distribution network is the last link of power supply, but in the face of extreme weather, failures are inevitable. How to complete the repair work of the distribution network at low cost and efficiently has become a research hotspot this year. Since many factors need to be considered in the emergency repair of distribution network faults, single-objective planning alone is not competent. Therefore, this paper solves the emergency repair problem of distribution network based on multi-objective optimization particle swarm optimization algorithm (MOSPO). In order to improve the performance of MOPSO, this paper uses the Taguchi method to customize the optimal parameters of the MOPSO algorithm, and proposes Ti-MOPSO. This paper uses NAGA II, IDBEA and Ti-MOPSO to conduct comparative tests. The test results show that the Ti-MOPSO proposed in this paper has excellent performance; in the simulation test, Ti-MOPSO can excellently complete the emergency repair plan planning of the distribution network.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of a Bidirectional Ankle Exoskeleton System
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Patients with foot-drop are unable to dorsiflexion during the swing phase, resulting in toe dragging and increasing the risk of falling. Ankle-foot-orthoses (AFOs) can reduce foot-drop of patients but limit their ankle plantarflexion. Assistive exoskeletons have a significant improvement on walking economy and the assistance can enhance human mobility. Here, we developed a bidirectional ankle exoskeleton to provide passive dorsiflexion assistance during the swing phase and active plantarflexion assistance during the stance phase. The performance of our exoskeleton was tested based on experiments of one healthy subject. We changed the front passive assistive materials and evaluated the kinematics and biological efforts of the subject with different assistive conditions. Results showed that the maximum ankle dorsiflexion angles were increased during the swing phase and ankle joint torques were reduced under assistance. The root mean square (RMS) of the soleus and tibialis anterior muscle activities were decreased by 21.8% and 17.9% under the assistance of elastic ropes condition. Our design expected to provide assistance for individuals with impaired dorsiflexion and plantarflexor muscle strength, which can enhance their locomotion ability.

articleTitle: An Ultra Wide Band RF Sampling System Based on Photoelectric Hybrid Technology
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the field of receiver, traditional heterodyne receiver is not able to meet needs for various reasons, and many applications are requiring the ability for direct sampling of high frequency and high bandwidth microwave signals. Currently, the commonly methods using to improve the conversion rate of ADC are limited by the physical limit of the transfer rate of semiconductor carriers, thus the front-end analog bandwidth is difficult to reach beyond 10GHz. However, the input bandwidth and quantization accuracy can be improved by using optical sampling. In this paper, an ultra wide band RF sampling system is realized by combining optical sampling and electrical quantization with photoelectric hybrid technology. Optical sampling of ultra-short optical pulses replaces the traditional sampling/holding circuit, enabling ultra-high speed sampling of ultra-wide band signals, and then uses the electronic ADC to encode the optical sampling signals in multi-channel time-division interleaved quantization, thus realizing the direct digitization of high frequency signals. In addition, linearization in the digital domain can further improve system performance. The system enables direct sampling of 40GHz microwave signals with a signal-to-noise ratio greater than 40dB.

articleTitle: Requirement of densely distributed PV grid-connected data analysis technology in the future new power system
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The distributed photovoltaic power generation system has the characteristics of close distance load, short transmission distance, good matching with electricity load, and easy on-site consumption. Since distributed photovoltaic is distributed to all voltage levels of the distribution network if the model is based on the centralized photovoltaic power station mode and models the parallel power stations one by one, it is necessary to add the corresponding power grid model, which is lower than 110 kV in the power grid analysis data file, which will lead to simulation results. The node size increases exponentially, and the convergence of the model decreases significantly. Therefore, it is necessary to study the analysis method under the background of distributed intensive integration, decouple the distributed PV from the load, appropriately aggregate the distributed PV, control the node size, and ensure the transient and steady state. The accuracy of response characteristic simulation puts forward new requirements for electromechanical and electromagnetic simulation. Considering the photovoltaic-intensive grid connection scenario in the future new power system, the photovoltaic grid connection scale is large, and the grid connection forms and voltage levels are different. Obviously, the analytical method of establishing an accurate PV model is no longer applicable, and different integration forms of PV need to be considered. The equivalent model of large-scale grid-connected PV is based, and a multi-voltage grid analysis method suitable for intensive PV grid-connected would be proposed.

articleTitle: Optimal Control of Connected Vehicles with Range-Limited and Time-Delay Communication
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper addresses the optimal control problem of connected vehicles with range-limited communication and communication delays. Firstly, we propose a novel non-model-based control strategy for connected vehicles under the effect of range-limited communication and communication delays. Meanwhile, a new optimal controller are introduced without depending on the model of dynamical systems, such as the drivers parameters. Moreover, stability criteria of the system and the convergence of the proposed algorithm are presented. Finally, the stability of the system and the convergence of the optimal control algorithm are verified by a numerical example.

articleTitle: Distributed Zeroth-order Optimization Over Directed Graphs
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper investigates the problem of distributed optimization over a directed graph. Additionally, each agent can only get zeroth-order (ZO) information of its objective function. The objective is to minimize the sum of the local cost functions without gradient information of the objective function. A novel distributed zeroth-order algorithm is developed over directed graphs based on the gradient estimator. The proposed algorithm is theoretically analyzed and shown to achieve linear convergence to a neighborhood of the optimal solution under strong convexity and smoothness assumptions. A key feature of the algorithm design is that it removes the dependence on the gradient of the objective function. The proposed algorithm are compared through numerical experiments on various datasets.

articleTitle: Distributed Neighbor Selection on Matrix-weighted Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper explores distributed neighbor selection in matrix-weighted networks, where a matrix-valued weight captures the interdependencies among agents’ states. We demonstrate the feasibility of preserving and, in certain cases, improving the convergence rate of matrix-weighted networks by having agents exclusively engage with a subset of their neighbors. Leveraging the inherent monotonicity of Laplacian matrix eigenvectors, we introduce a novel neighbor selection criterion that reduces network connections while enhancing convergence rates. Existing neighbor selection strategies often require acquiring information from all nodes before making decisions. In order to propose a distributed neighbor selection strategy for matrix-weighted networks, we establish a numerical relationship between Laplacian eigenvectors and a locally measurable metric. In essence, this paper extends prior findings from scalar-weighted networks to matrix-weighted networks.

articleTitle: An Elevator Dynamic Group Control Algorithm Based on Comprehensive Judgment of Time and Distance
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Economic progress has provided the necessary guarantee for the development of high-rise buildings. Elevators, as a respected mode of transportation, play a key role in ordinary life and work. It is of great significance to reduce the system energy consumption of elevators. In this paper, we propose a dynamic group control algorithm that integrates time and distance judgment, combined with the application of penalty function to make the algorithm more standardized. Instead of just setting the weight as a constant, we can control the weights according to the direction of operation and location of the elevators and its parameters. We built the PLC program in TIA Portal software for six 10-story elevators as the control object. Then, we simulated and debugged it in the EET elevator simulation software of the host computer with a Siemens S7-1200 PLC controller. Finally, simulation results prove the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Stochastic Resonance Effect in Multisensor Decision and Fusion Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this paper, stochastic resonance (SR) effect in multisensor decision and fusion systems is investigated under Bayes criterion. To this end, a necessary condition is established to determine the improvability of a detector using SR. Furthermore, we discuss performances of additive noises, which are added in different positions in the systems. The optimal noise in multisensor decision and fusion systems is proved to be constant. It is concluded that the benefits by adding additive noises only appears where noises are added after the sensor rules and before the fusion rule. Finally, a numerical example is presented to corroborate the above theoretical results.

articleTitle: Optimization of Submarine Degaussing Current Based on Parameter Adaptive Particle Swarm Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Submarines are the main underwater combat force in our country. In order to reduce the possibility of submarines being discovered by airborne magnetic detectors and magnetic mines when operating underwater, this paper proposes a parameter adaptive particle swarm algorithm to optimize the current of the degaussing coil of the submarine degaussing system. Using the two test functions of Ackley and Rastrigin to test the improved algorithm, it can be seen that the optimization accuracy of the parameter adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm has been improved by 2-4 orders of magnitude. Applying the improved algorithm to the single-component and multi-component submarine degaussing current optimization model, the degaussing rate of the induced magnetic field of each component of the submarine has been significantly improved, the degaussing rate of the X component has increased by 9.56%, the degaussing rate of the Y component has increased by 8.76% and Z component degaussing rate increased by 5.53%.

articleTitle: Defect detection of laptop appearance based on improved multi-scale normalizing flows
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the laptop production process, timely detection of appearance defects is essential to ensure product quality. At present, there are many shortcomings in the manual visual detection based method on the laptops production line. In addition, due to the wide variety of laptop appearance defects and extreme differences in defect scales, existing defect detection algorithms perform poorly in the field of laptop appearance detection. In response to the above problems, this paper proposes a defect detection algorithm based on improved multi-scale normalizing flows. First, the multi-level features extracted from the backbone network are fused by using the pyramid feature fusion module to obtain multi-scale features with rich semantic and spatial information. Then, the effective density estimation of the multi-scale features is achieved by fusing the normalizing flows of attention mechanisms. Finally, the defects are detected and localized based on the output likelihood values. The experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method in detecting and locating appearance defects.

articleTitle: Modelling and Simulation of Autonomous Decision - making Process Based on Proximal Policy Optimization
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The autonomous decision-making problem in the mixed process of medium-range and close-range confrontation stages of agents is studied in this paper, utilizing reinforcement learning theory. The complexity and intensity of the environment resulting from the integration of information technology and system-of-systems (SoS) support in the agent confrontation scenario, as well as the oversimplification of scenarios in traditional research on autonomous decision-making of agents, are taken into account. Firstly, a simulation platform is constructed based on the Agent-Based Modeling and Simulation (ABMS). Then, the state space, action space, and reward function are designed to adapt to the multi-stage confrontation scenario for agents. Finally, an autonomous decision-making method based on Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) algorithm for agent confrontation is proposed. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed decision-making algorithm can learn reasonable confrontation tactics in multi-stage confrontation scenarios, verifying the feasibility of studying the problem based on the above modeling and simulation framework.

articleTitle: A Portable Proximity Sensing System Based on Capacitive Micromachined Ultrasonic Transducer
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This paper reports a resonant proximity sensing system based on a capacitive micromachined ultrasonic transducer (CMUT), which has advantages of low cost, high sensitivity, and fast response. An equivalent circuit model of the CMUT was established and used for the design of the Colpitts oscillating circuit, which tracked the parallel resonance frequency of the sensor. Simulations of the oscillator demonstrated its capability of responding to the loaded mass of water molecules from the fingertip. A signal acquisition system based on the oscillator and the STM32 microcontroller has been built and its frequency stability was examined. The feasibility of the CMUT sensor as a proximity sensor has been experimentally evaluated. A maximum frequency shift of 55 kHz was achieved as the fingertip moved from 20 mm to 2 mm from the surface of the sensor. Short response and recovery times of 0.65 s and 0.85 s were achieved by the sensing system.

articleTitle: Research on Defect Data of Distribution Transformers Based on Fusion Text Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Distribution transformers are important devices in power distribution networks. The mining of defect texts related to distribution transformers can provide valuable information that impacts the safe and stable operation of these transformers. However, due to the complexity and large volume of textual data in the power grid domain, the application of text mining is still in its early stages in China’s power system. This paper focuses on the research of a semantic recognition-based clustering algorithm for defect texts of distribution transformers. It aims to uncover potential patterns among these defect texts and contribute to the operation and maintenance of distribution networks.First, the semantic recognition of defect texts in distribution transformers is implemented to generate semantic vectors. Then, a clustering algorithm framework based on semantic vectors for defect texts in distribution transformers is proposed. Since the semantic vectors obtained from text representation models contain the main feature information of the texts and can be directly processed by computers, they can be inputted into different clustering algorithms to achieve clustering of defect texts in distribution transformers. Next, clustering experiments on defect texts in distribution transformers are conducted. Four different types of clustering algorithms are used to cluster the text feature vectors obtained from different text representation models. The experimental results are then compared and analyzed based on three clustering evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Multiple-target enclosing control using bearing-only measurements
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In the past few years, there has been significant progress in the development of enclosing control approaches for various applications in military and civilian domains. This study explores the use of a multi-agent system (MAS) equipped with bearing-only sensors to address the enclosing control problem for multiple targets in a constrained environment. The crux of this issue is to estimate the geometric center of multiple targets with limited information, such as bearing measurements to a subset of targets and message exchanges with neighboring agents. This paper proposes a composite estimator, by which an agent can firstly generate its individual opinion of the center by the collected bearing measurements to its observable targets; then their opinions are exchanged in the network to reach an agreement of the geometric center. Based on this, the MAS can achieve the target circular formation by rotating at a predetermined radius and rotational speed about the center. The proposed method’s efficacy and efficiency are confirmed by thorough theoretical analysis and numerical simulation.

articleTitle: Analysis and selection of polarization control waveplates based on extended Jones matrix in SERF co-magnetometer *
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: The polarization of the probe light is an important parameter of the SERF co-magnetometer probe system, which is related to the stability and measurement accuracy of the SERF co-magnetometer. The theoretical analysis and experimental testing of the phase-retardation of the wave-plate which is a key element in the polarization adjustment of the probe light, are carried out in this paper. The mapping model of phase retardation with respect to the angle of incidence of light is developed based on an extended Jones matrix model of the waveplate. Moreover, the corresponding theoretical verification experiments are designed based on the established. Waveplates with different processes and retardation accuracies are used for the experimental tests and the corresponding measurement errors are analyzed. The scheme provides a theoretical basis and experimental method for the selection of elements in the SERF co-magnetometer. This helps to improve the accuracy of the polarization adjustment of the probe light and the performance of the interference-free probe system.

articleTitle: Research of Flight Trajectory Trend Prediction System Based on RBF Network
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Aircraft flight trajectory trend prediction has become an important part of air combat technology. The maturity of this technology has important research significance and application value in military, industrial and other fields. In order to improve the real-time performance of the prediction algorithm, this paper proposes to establish a flight trajectory trend prediction system based on the RBF network, install a high-definition camera to obtain the single station measurement video, build a motion trend prediction network model through the previous motion trend learning and training against the historical data of the land section, and realize the intelligent prediction of aircraft motion trend. The system can combine with the flight state parameters to modify the learning network which is modified to improve the accuracy and robustness of the trend prediction network. Then the system will achieve rapid and accurate results.

articleTitle: Distributed Data-driven Event-Triggered H∞ Consensus for Unknown Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Systems
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This brief proposes a distributed data-driven algorithm to solve the consensus control problem of continuous heterogeneous linear multi-agent systems with unknown dynamics and disturbance signals. Firstly, the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> control is used to suppress disturbance signals. And then in order to reduce the complexity of H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> controller design for heterogeneous systems, the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> consensus problem is solved with the application of the alternating direction method of multiplier. Next, for the unknown dynamics of agents, a novel data-driven method is used to solve the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> consensus problem when only the input and output information of the multi-agent system can be obtained. Besides, in order to further reduce the communication frequency, a dynamic event-triggered scheme is designed for the H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">∞</inf> consensus control algorithm. It is proved that the event-triggered consensus algorithm is stable and does not produce Zeno behavior. Finally, an example is given to verify the effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Synchronization and Control for Discrete-Time Multiplex Networks
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: Exponential synchronization of multiplex networks is investigated. The complex network is described by discrete-time difference equation. The network has multiple weights, and the network topology can be directed and not strongly connected. Moreover, switching topology case is also considered in this paper. With rearranging variables’ order technique, we obtain some sufficient criteria for exponential synchronization and pinning control. Simulation examples are also given.

articleTitle: Asynchronous Control of T-S Fuzzy Networked Control Systems with A Dynamic Event-Triggered Strategy and Its Application
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In this article, the asynchronous control problem of fuzzy networked control systems (NCSs) with an efficient dynamic event-triggered (DET) strategy is studied. Particularly, an time-varying variable is designed to regulate the triggering threshold, which changes with the system error states. Different from the existing results, the proposed DET is sample-data-based, which can be exclude the Zeno behaviour naturally. In addition, to solve the mismatch induced by the DET strategy, the asynchronous controller is designed. By using the Lyapunov stability theory, some stability conditions can be obtained. Finally, an example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Aperiodically Intermittent Control for Fixed-Time Stability Under Denial-of-Service Attack
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: This article considers aperiodically intermittent control (AIC) for fixed-time stability under Denial-of-Service (DoS) attack. To enhance the effectiveness of detecting and mitigating diverse forms of DoS attacks, our approach utilizes a classification method that centers on the frequency and duration attributes of the attack signals. For AIC, the utilization of average control rate yields less conservative results. By applying the Lyapunov method, the fixed-time stability theorem is established for AIC under DoS attack, which provides necessary conditions to fixed-time stability of cyber-physical systems (CPSs) in the presence of DoS attacks. Finally, a numerical example is given to verify the effectiveness of theoretical results.

articleTitle: A Technique for Speeding Up Fractal Graph Drawing
publicationTitle: 2023 38th Youth Academic Annual Conference of Chinese Association of Automation (YAC)
abstract: In view of the slow speed of fractal graph drawing with character substitution method, this paper gives two methods to increase the speed of fractal graph drawing. First, the string is stored in two sequential tables instead of one, and the new string is generated by table tail insertion method, thus avoiding a large number of element movements during insertion. Second, new strings are generated by a shared stack operation on a single sequential table, again avoiding the problem of a large number of element movements during new string generation.
